<!DOCTYPE html>
<!--
    Import_Builder.htm — External CSV → Fishbowl PPVP / Customer / Vendor

    Plan: ~/.claude/plans/vivid-watching-wadler.md

    Three-stage pipeline:
      1. INGEST  — drag/drop CSV; auto-detect source shape (Shopify Products /
                   Shopify Customers in v1) → target Fishbowl schema.
      2. MAP+EDIT — field-mapping modal pre-fills via autoMatchScore; results
                   render as an inline-editable table with a per-column
                   bulk-overwrite control. Reference-vocabulary columns (tax
                   code, payment terms, carriers, ship terms, etc.) become
                   <select>s populated from live Fishbowl queries.
      3. EXPORT  — Fishbowl-shaped CSV with canonical column order, RFC-4180
                   quoted. (Direct ImportRq push deferred to v2.)

    Patterns lifted (verbatim or close):
      - PPP_Pricing_Validator.htm  — parseCSV/parseCSVLine, validateType,
        PPP_COLUMNS schema, modal pattern.
      - Solidworks_BOM_Converter.htm — design tokens, .hdr-btn, panel-overlay
        slide-ins, .upload-section drag-drop pattern, .stat-badge, toast,
        FBLib.Settings init pattern.

    Schemas:
      - Customer + Vendor: user-supplied canonical column lists (39 / 30 cols).
      - PPVP: lifted from PPP_Pricing_Validator.htm's PPP_COLUMNS.
-->
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Import Builder — External → Fishbowl</title>

    <!-- Tailwind CDN (utility classes for layout glue only — design tokens drive everything else). -->
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <script>
        tailwind.config = { theme: { extend: { colors: { primary: '#2d9cdb', 'primary-dark': '#1e7bb4' } } } };
    </script>

    <!-- Inter font (canonical for sibling reports). -->
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <!-- Shared Fishbowl BI lib — inlined by Fishbowl from the saved "fb-lib"
         script. Source of truth: scripts/fb-lib.js. -->
    <script>
        {% Script fb-lib %}
    </script>

    <!-- Shared Fishbowl BI stylesheet — injected by Fishbowl from the saved
         "fb-styles" Style. Source of truth: scripts/fb-styles.css. Carries
         design tokens, .hdr-btn / .btn / .fb-drawer / .stat-badge / .toast /
         .app-tooltip / .modal-* / .filters-* / .columns-* and friends.

         MUST come BEFORE the per-report <style> block below so identical
         selectors in this report override the shared ones (same precedence
         model as a vendor reset followed by app overrides). -->
    <style>
        {% Style fb-styles %}
    </style>

    <style>
        /* =====================================================
           PER-REPORT OVERRIDES + REPORT-SPECIFIC RULES
           ----
           Tokens, base reset, typography, .hdr-btn, .btn, forms, alerts,
           .stat-badge, .config-group, .info-box, .fb-drawer, .ds-*, .modal-*,
           .app-tooltip, .toast, .filters-popover, .columns-popover, .src-chip,
           scrollbar, spinner, .text-* utilities, and the `header` chrome all
           live in fb-styles.css now. Removing them from this block kept the
           file lean while leaving every Import-Builder-specific rule in
           place (body flex layout, .app-shell, .upload-hero, .summary-stats,
           .mapping-*, .import-table, frozen-left, etc.).
           ===================================================== */
        /* body — re-declared to layer the IB-specific flex layout + debug
           drawer reservation on top of fb-styles' base body rule. */
        body {
            /* Flex column: header (sticky) + drawers + .app-shell. .app-shell
               itself flexes so the results table can fill all leftover
               vertical space. */
            display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 100vh;
            height: 100%;
            /* Reserved bottom strip = current debug-drawer height. Set by
               JS when the drawer opens/resizes; 0 when the drawer is shut.
               Keeps the always-fixed debug drawer from covering the last
               row(s) of the table. */
            padding-bottom: var(--debug-drawer-h, 0px);
            transition: padding-bottom 0.12s ease;
        }
        html { height: 100%; }

        /* =====================================================
           PAGE WRAP + CARDS
           ===================================================== */
        /* Full available width — no max-width cap. The results table can
           grow to 40+ columns wide and the user benefits from every pixel
           of horizontal room. Padding gives a small visual gutter from
           the viewport edges.
           --
           CLASS NAME: `.app-shell`, NOT `.container`. Tailwind ships a
           `.container` utility class with responsive max-width caps
           (640 / 768 / 1024 / 1280 / 1536 px at each breakpoint). Those
           media-query rules have the same specificity as ours and load
           AFTER our inline <style> via the CDN, so they win the cascade
           and clip the page at 1536px. Using a unique class name avoids
           the collision entirely. */
        .app-shell {
            width: 100%; max-width: none; margin: 0; padding: 0;
            /* Flex column so #resultsCard can flex:1 and the results-table
               container fills all remaining vertical space. min-height:0 is
               required for nested flex containers to shrink/expand
               correctly when their content is taller than the viewport.
               ----
               Padding is 0 so the data table goes edge-to-edge — matching
               PurchaseOrderSummary's layout. The hero, KPI strip, and any
               other content above the table re-add their own padding so
               they don't look flush to the viewport edge. */
            flex: 1 1 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0;
        }
        .card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.03); margin-bottom: 16px; }
        /* Results "card" is no longer a card — no border, no shadow, no
           border-radius. It's just the flex container that holds the
           toolbar bar + the edge-to-edge scrolling table below. Stretches
           to fill leftover vertical space below the hero / drawer / KPI
           strip. */
        #resultsCard {
            flex: 1 1 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
            min-height: 240px; margin-bottom: 0;
            background: transparent !important; border: 0 !important;
            border-radius: 0 !important; box-shadow: none !important;
        }
        #resultsCard > .results-table-container { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; }

        /* Typography (h1-h6 + .subtitle), .btn family, form controls
           (input/select/.form-check), and .alert family all live in
           fb-styles.css now. */

        /* =====================================================
           UPLOAD HERO — pre-file full-width drop zone
           ----
           This is the big initial affordance on a fresh page. As soon
           as a CSV is loaded, the hero is hidden and #controlDrawer
           takes over (see below). The drag-drop handlers are attached
           to BOTH the hero and the mini drop zone inside the drawer.
           ===================================================== */
        .upload-hero {
            padding: 32px 24px; background: #fff;
            border: 2px dashed #cbd5e1; border-radius: 12px;
            text-align: center; margin: 16px 20px;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
        }
        .upload-hero:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary); background: #f8fafc; }
        .upload-hero.dragover { border-color: #10b981; background: #d1fae5; border-style: solid; }
        .upload-hero h2 {
            margin: 0 0 6px 0; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;
        }
        .upload-hero .lead { font-size: 13px; color: #64748b; margin: 4px 0 16px; line-height: 1.5; }
        .upload-hero .btn { padding: 9px 16px; font-size: 13px; }

        /* =====================================================
           SOURCE DRAWER — toggle button beside the KPI tiles.
           ----
           The post-file source/target chip + Edit-mapping + Reset +
           "drop another CSV" mini-zone live in a standard .fb-drawer
           drop-down (see #sourceOverlay markup below). The KPI row
           gets a small toggle button (.kpi-toggle-btn) styled to read
           as a button-among-chips: same height + border-radius as the
           stat-badge pills, but with a colour treatment that says
           "click me" rather than "I am a count".
           ===================================================== */
        .kpi-toggle-btn {
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
            padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 999px;
            font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4;
            border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; background: #fff; color: #334155;
            cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; white-space: nowrap;
            transition: background 0.12s, border-color 0.12s, color 0.12s;
        }
        .kpi-toggle-btn:hover { background: #f1f5f9; border-color: #94a3b8; }
        .kpi-toggle-btn.active {
            background: #eff6ff; border-color: #bfdbfe; color: var(--color-primary-dark);
        }
        .kpi-toggle-btn svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .kpi-toggle-btn .kpi-toggle-summary {
            color: #64748b; font-weight: 500;
            overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;
            max-width: 360px;
        }

        /* =====================================================
           UPLOAD SECTION (drag-drop) — single-row pill inside the drawer
           ----
           Used as the mini "drop another CSV" inside #controlDrawer's
           body. Hero (full-width) lives in .upload-hero above.
           Laid out as one horizontal row: label + "or" + Choose button.
           The previously-shown filename is gone — the drawer header
           summary already reports it ("Source → Target · file.csv").
           ===================================================== */
        .upload-section {
            padding: 6px 12px; background: #fff;
            border: 2px dashed #cbd5e1; border-radius: 999px;
            margin-bottom: 0;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .upload-section:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary); background: #f8fafc; }
        .upload-section.dragover { border-color: #10b981; background: #d1fae5; border-style: solid; }
        .upload-section .upload-mini-label {
            font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #1e293b;
            text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        }
        .upload-section .upload-mini-sep {
            font-size: 11px; color: #94a3b8;
        }
        .upload-section .btn { padding: 3px 10px; font-size: 11px; }

        /* =====================================================
           SUMMARY STATS — strip layout. The .stat-badge pills themselves
           (and the .kpi click-to-filter variant) live in fb-styles.css.
           ===================================================== */
        .summary-stats { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 20px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; margin-bottom: 0; flex-shrink: 0; }

        /* .config-group / .config-item / .form-check and .info-box all live
           in fb-styles.css now. */

        /* =====================================================
           FIELD MAPPING MODAL ROWS
           ----
           Tracks: `minmax(0, 1fr) auto minmax(0, 1fr)` rather than the
           older `45% 10% 45%`. With the old setup, percentages summed to
           100% AND `gap: 8px` added another 16px on top — so every row
           was exactly 16px wider than the modal body, pushing the select
           dropdowns off the right edge. `1fr` tracks share the space LEFT
           AFTER gaps, and `minmax(0, …)` lets each side track shrink
           below its child's intrinsic min-content (a long source-column
           option name otherwise prevents the select from collapsing to
           the track width, recreating the overflow). The middle column is
           `auto` because the `←` arrow doesn't need to flex.
           ===================================================== */
        .mapping-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto minmax(0, 1fr);
            align-items: center; gap: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 8px; padding: 7px;
            background: #fff; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
        }
        .mapping-label { font-weight: 500; color: #1e293b; font-size: 12px; }
        .mapping-arrow { color: var(--color-primary); font-size: 14px; text-align: center; }
        /* `min-width: 0` is the belt-and-braces companion to the
           `minmax(0, 1fr)` track — even in browsers that respect the
           track's min-size, a <select> with a very long option set can
           still try to push wider via flex sizing; min-width:0 ensures
           it stays inside its track. */
        .mapping-select {
            padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 12px; width: 100%; min-width: 0;
            background: #fff; color: #1e293b;
        }
        .mapping-select:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(45,156,219,0.15); }
        .required-field::after { content: " *"; color: #ef4444; }
        .mapping-select.is-invalid { border-color: #ef4444; }
        .mapping-note { font-size: 10px; color: #94a3b8; font-weight: 400; }

        /* =====================================================
           RESULTS TABLE — inline edit + column-overwrite bar
           ===================================================== */
        /* No max-height — the parent flex chain (#resultsCard > this >
           overflow:auto) lets the table fill all remaining viewport
           height. `min-height` keeps the table usable on very short
           windows where the header/drawer/stats already consume most
           of the page. No border / border-radius so the table is
           visually flush to the viewport edges (matches the
           PurchaseOrderSummary layout). */
        .results-table-container { min-height: 200px; overflow: auto; background: #fff; }
        table.import-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; }
        table.import-table thead th {
            background: #f8fafc; padding: 6px 10px; text-align: left;
            font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #475569;
            text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10;
            white-space: nowrap; vertical-align: bottom;
        }
        /* Second header row carries the column-overwrite control. Sticky below
           the title row so the bulk-edit affordance stays in view as the user
           scrolls a long table.
           ----
           `top` is set DYNAMICALLY by _alignStickyHeaders() (in JS) to the
           actual measured height of the title row. The 50px here is just a
           pre-paint placeholder so the row doesn't render at top:0 before
           the first render call lands. Without the JS realignment, the bulk
           row's content (two stacked control rows: value+scope+apply on
           top of copy-from+scope+apply) makes the title row's height vary,
           and a static `top` would either leave a gap above the bulk row OR
           overlap the first body row — making rows 1–2 unreachable at
           scrollTop=0. See `_alignStickyHeaders()` in the JS section.
           ----
           `vertical-align: top` (overrides the title row's bottom align)
           pins the bulk row's content to the top of the cell, so when the
           sticky offset puts the row at exactly `titleRowHeight` there's
           no whitespace below the title row's text and above the controls. */
        table.import-table thead tr.bulk-row th {
            top: 50px; z-index: 9; padding: 4px 6px;
            background: #eff6ff; border-bottom: 2px solid #bfdbfe;
            vertical-align: top;
        }
        table.import-table thead tr.bulk-row th input,
        table.import-table thead tr.bulk-row th select {
            width: 100%; min-width: 80px;
            padding: 3px 6px; font-size: 11px; border-radius: 5px;
            border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; background: #fff;
        }
        .col-required { color: #ef4444; font-weight: 700; margin-left: 2px; }
        .col-name { color: #1e293b; }
        .col-meta { font-size: 10px; color: #94a3b8; font-weight: 400; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; }

        /* --------------------------------------------------------------
           SORT + FILTER controls in the grey title cell.
           Visually distinct from the blue bulk-overwrite row — these
           change what the user SEES (display order, narrowing); the blue
           row CHANGES the data. Keeping them in separate sticky bands
           reinforces that read-only vs write-data split.
           --------------------------------------------------------------
           ALSO: the per-column "remap source" icon button + popover
           live in this band. Clicking the small arrow-swap icon next
           to a column name opens a floating selector that lets the
           user redirect that column's source mapping without going
           back to the field-mapping modal.
           -------------------------------------------------------------- */
        .col-remap-btn {
            background: transparent; border: none; color: #94a3b8; cursor: pointer;
            padding: 1px 2px; border-radius: 3px;
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            margin-left: 4px; vertical-align: middle;
            font-family: inherit; line-height: 1;
        }
        .col-remap-btn:hover { color: var(--color-primary); background: #eff6ff; }
        .col-remap-btn:active { color: var(--color-primary-dark); }
        .col-remap-btn svg { width: 11px; height: 11px; display: block; }

        .col-remap-popover {
            position: fixed; z-index: 200;
            background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px;
            box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.18);
            padding: 12px 14px;
            min-width: 280px; max-width: 360px;
            font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif;
            font-size: 12px;
            /* Reset table-header style inheritance so the popover's
               text isn't uppercase-tracked. */
            text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: 400;
        }
        .col-remap-popover .crp-label {
            font-size: 11px; color: #475569; font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }
        .col-remap-popover .crp-title {
            font-size: 13px; color: #0f172a; font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }
        .col-remap-popover .crp-current {
            font-size: 11px; color: #94a3b8; margin-bottom: 8px;
        }
        .col-remap-popover .crp-current code {
            background: #f1f5f9; color: #1e293b; padding: 1px 5px;
            border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11px;
        }
        .col-remap-popover select {
            width: 100%; padding: 7px 9px; font-size: 12px;
            border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px;
            background: #fff; color: #1e293b; font-family: inherit;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .col-remap-popover select:focus {
            outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(45,156,219,0.15);
        }
        .col-remap-popover .crp-actions {
            display: flex; gap: 6px; justify-content: flex-end;
        }
        .col-header-btn {
            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 4px; cursor: pointer; user-select: none;
        }
        .col-header-btn:hover .col-name { color: var(--color-primary); }
        /* Sort indicator — SVG icon matching the .col-remap-btn size +
           stroke style. Idle state is the remap arrow-swap rotated 90°
           (vertical two-headed), so the two header-row affordances read
           as a matched set. Active states show a single up- or down-
           pointing arrow tinted primary so the sort direction is obvious
           at a glance. */
        .col-sort-indicator {
            color: #cbd5e1; line-height: 1;
            transition: color 0.12s;
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            padding-left: 4px; flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .col-sort-indicator svg { width: 11px; height: 11px; display: block; }
        .col-sort-indicator.active { color: var(--color-primary); }
        .col-header-btn:hover .col-sort-indicator { color: #94a3b8; }
        .col-header-btn:hover .col-sort-indicator.active { color: var(--color-primary-dark); }

        .col-filter {
            margin-top: 4px; width: 100%;
            /* Explicit height + line-height keep <input type="text"> and
               <select> visually identical. Without this, browsers render
               <select> 2-4px taller than <input> (intrinsic form-control
               metrics differ + the native dropdown arrow nudges height).
               Because the title <th> uses vertical-align: bottom, any
               height drift here cascades upward: a taller filter pushes
               its column's meta + name a few pixels above the columns
               with a shorter filter, breaking the header grid. Box-sizing
               is border-box globally so 26px is the FULL outer height. */
            box-sizing: border-box;
            height: 26px;
            padding: 3px 6px; font-size: 11px;
            line-height: 1.4;
            border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px;
            background: #fff; color: #1e293b; font-family: inherit;
            /* The parent <th> applies uppercase + tracking; the filter is
               user-typed text so override both. */
            text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: 500;
        }
        /* Selects need a touch more right padding so the native dropdown
           arrow doesn't crowd the selected option's text. */
        select.col-filter { padding-right: 18px; }
        .col-filter:focus {
            outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(45,156,219,0.15);
        }
        /* Highlight when the filter holds a value so the user can see at
           a glance which columns are narrowing the view. Toggled in JS
           because :placeholder-shown doesn't apply to <select>. */
        .col-filter.has-value {
            border-color: var(--color-primary);
            background: #eff6ff;
        }
        .bulk-apply-btn {
            width: 100%; padding: 3px 6px; font-size: 10px; border-radius: 5px;
            background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--color-primary-dark);
            cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; font-family: inherit;
        }
        .bulk-apply-btn:hover { background: var(--color-primary-dark); }
        /* Compact checkmark variant — used after the redesign that swapped
           the "Apply" word for a ✓ glyph. Square-ish, slightly bigger glyph
           so it reads as a button at a glance. */
        .bulk-apply-btn.bulk-apply-tick {
            width: 26px; min-width: 26px;
            padding: 2px 4px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1;
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
        }
        .bulk-apply-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 4px; align-items: center; }

        table.import-table tbody td {
            padding: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #eef2f7; vertical-align: middle;
        }
        table.import-table tbody td .cell {
            padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; color: #1e293b; min-height: 26px;
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
            border: 1px solid transparent;
            border-radius: 4px; margin: 1px;
        }
        table.import-table tbody td .cell:hover { background: #f8fafc; border-color: #e2e8f0; }
        table.import-table tbody td .cell-input,
        table.import-table tbody td .cell-select {
            width: 100%; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent;
            background: transparent; font-size: 12px; color: #1e293b;
            font-family: inherit; border-radius: 4px;
        }
        table.import-table tbody td .cell-input:focus,
        table.import-table tbody td .cell-select:focus {
            outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary);
            background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(45,156,219,0.15);
        }
        /* Cell with a required-but-empty value or a typed validation failure
           gets a soft red wash so the user can scan for problems at a glance. */
        table.import-table tbody td.cell-issue { background: #fef2f2; }
        table.import-table tbody td.cell-issue .cell-input,
        table.import-table tbody td.cell-issue .cell-select { color: #991b1b; }
        /* Soft warning — vocab mismatch on a non-required field. Indicates
           the value exists but doesn't match the live Fishbowl reference
           list; user can fix via column-overwrite if they care. Lighter
           wash than `cell-issue` so the user can tell the two apart at
           a glance. */
        table.import-table tbody td.cell-warning { background: #fffbeb; }
        table.import-table tbody td.cell-warning .cell-input,
        table.import-table tbody td.cell-warning .cell-select { color: #92400e; }
        table.import-table tbody tr:hover td:not(.cell-issue):not(.cell-warning) { background: #fafbfc; }

        /* Per-cell drag-drop was removed (2026-06-27) — see
           ~/.claude/plans/vivid-watching-wadler.md notes. It was slow on
           large imports and copy-paste in the cell editors is the same
           number of clicks for the same outcome. The CSS rules
           (.cell-grip, .cell-wrap, td.drop-target) and the
           _wireCellDragDrop() helper have been removed. The Copy-from-
           column control in the bulk-overwrite row covers the
           "value-from-elsewhere" use case at scale. */
        /* Bulk control scope <select> — narrower than form-select-sm so the
           strip stays compact. */
        .bulk-scope-select {
            padding: 3px 4px; font-size: 10px; border-radius: 5px;
            border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; background: #fff;
            min-width: 0; width: 100%;
        }

        /* Per-row select checkbox — sits to the LEFT of the delete button.
           Top-of-column checkbox is tri-state: unchecked / indeterminate
           (some visible selected) / checked (all visible selected) and
           operates only on currently-visible rows so a filter narrows what
           "select all" means. Selection itself persists across filter/sort
           changes — see state.selectedRows. */
        table.import-table .row-select-cell {
            width: 28px; padding: 4px 4px 4px 8px; text-align: center;
            background: #f8fafc;   /* match the title-row bg so the column reads as metadata */
        }
        table.import-table .row-select-cell input[type="checkbox"] {
            cursor: pointer; margin: 0; vertical-align: middle;
        }
        /* When a row is selected, give the whole row a faint primary tint
           so the user can see the selection at a glance — even when the
           checkbox column is scrolled off-screen horizontally. */
        table.import-table tbody tr.row-selected td:not(.cell-issue):not(.cell-warning) {
            background: #eff6ff;
        }
        table.import-table tbody tr.row-selected .row-select-cell { background: #dbeafe; }
        /* "Delete N selected" toolbar button. Red so it's obviously
           destructive; disabled (and grey) when 0 selected. */
        .btn.btn-danger { background: #dc2626; color: #fff; border-color: #b91c1c; }
        .btn.btn-danger:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #b91c1c; border-color: #991b1b; }

        /* Per-row delete button — sits to the RIGHT of the select checkbox.
           The button itself is tiny + low-contrast by default so it doesn't
           draw the eye away from the data; turns red on hover so it's
           obvious what it does when the user reaches for it. Confirmation
           modal still gates the actual delete to prevent accidents. */
        table.import-table .row-delete-cell {
            width: 28px; padding: 4px 2px 4px 8px; text-align: center;
        }
        .row-delete-btn {
            background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent;
            color: #cbd5e1; cursor: pointer;
            width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 5px;
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            font-family: inherit; line-height: 1; padding: 0;
            transition: all 0.12s ease;
        }
        .row-delete-btn:hover {
            background: #fee2e2; border-color: #fca5a5; color: #b91c1c;
        }
        .row-delete-btn svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; display: block; }

        /* Row-status pill in the leftmost column. */
        table.import-table .row-status-cell { width: 90px; padding: 4px 8px; }
        .row-status {
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
            padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 999px;
            font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4;
            border: 1px solid; white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .row-status.ready  { background: #d1fae5; border-color: #6ee7b7; color: #065f46; }
        .row-status.issues { background: #fef3c7; border-color: #fcd34d; color: #92400e; }
        .row-status.skipped { background: #f1f5f9; border-color: #cbd5e1; color: #64748b; }
        /* Source-row index column. Read-only in the body (so the user can
           correlate a target row back to its original CSV row) but the
           HEADER cell is click-to-sort: ascending puts rows back into the
           source-CSV order, which is the natural "undo any sort" gesture.
           Width bumped from 50 -> 64 to fit the sort indicator next to
           the "Src #" label. */
        table.import-table .source-row-cell {
            width: 64px; padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 10px; color: #94a3b8;
            text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        /* =====================================================
           FROZEN FIRST COLUMN  (Excel-style "Freeze First Column")
           ----
           When the user clicks the lock icon on the first schema
           column's header, `state.frozenFirstCol` flips on and JS adds
           `.col-locked` + an inline `left:<px>` to every cell in the
           metadata columns + the first schema column. Combined with the
           thead's existing `position: sticky; top: 0`, those cells stay
           pinned to the top-left while the rest of the table scrolls
           in both axes.
           ----
           Background colour is critical: without it, other rows'
           content scrolls behind these sticky cells and shows through.
           We use a solid white default + a slightly darker tint for the
           metadata band so it visually groups together. Selected rows
           keep their primary tint; issue / warning cells keep their
           red / amber wash. The cell-state classes apply !important to
           win over the .col-locked base.
           ----
           Right-edge drop shadow on the LAST locked cell gives a clear
           visual cue that the columns are pinned (otherwise the lock
           looks like a no-op when the scroll position is at 0). */
        /* Freeze-first-column is implemented via pure CSS + 3 CSS
           variables — no per-cell JS, no per-row layout reads. The JS
           function _applyFrozenColumns() does ONE pass per render: it
           measures 5 widths from the first row and sets --lock-l1..l4
           on the table. The :nth-child rules below then apply
           `position: sticky` to the matching cell in every row, so
           lazy-appended rows pick up the freeze automatically without
           any JS touching them. This replaced an earlier loop that
           called getBoundingClientRect() per cell per row, which was
           forcing ~1000 synchronous layouts per render and dominating
           the page's frame time on large imports. */
        table.import-table.frozen-left tr > :nth-child(1),
        table.import-table.frozen-left tr > :nth-child(2),
        table.import-table.frozen-left tr > :nth-child(3),
        table.import-table.frozen-left tr > :nth-child(4),
        table.import-table.frozen-left tr > :nth-child(5) {
            position: sticky;
            background: #fff;
            z-index: 8 !important;
        }
        /* The first four are the metadata band (select / delete / status /
           src#) — left offsets default to the known CSS widths. The fifth
           is the first schema column (PartNumber / Name) — left offset
           depends on the sum of the four widths, which varies in practice
           because of cell padding & content. JS measures the actual
           accumulated width once per render and sets these vars. */
        table.import-table.frozen-left tr > :nth-child(1) { left: 0; }
        table.import-table.frozen-left tr > :nth-child(2) { left: var(--lock-l1, 28px); }
        table.import-table.frozen-left tr > :nth-child(3) { left: var(--lock-l2, 56px); }
        table.import-table.frozen-left tr > :nth-child(4) { left: var(--lock-l3, 146px); }
        table.import-table.frozen-left tr > :nth-child(5) { left: var(--lock-l4, 210px); }
        /* Metadata band tint (cols 1-4) reads as "this is the frozen
           gutter" — slight off-white. */
        table.import-table.frozen-left tr > :nth-child(1),
        table.import-table.frozen-left tr > :nth-child(2),
        table.import-table.frozen-left tr > :nth-child(3),
        table.import-table.frozen-left tr > :nth-child(4) {
            background: #f8fafc;
        }
        /* Edge marker on the last frozen column — drop-shadow makes the
           freeze boundary obvious to the user. */
        table.import-table.frozen-left tr > :nth-child(5) {
            box-shadow: 4px 0 6px -3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18);
        }
        /* Z-index: the frozen thead must beat scrolling thead siblings;
           the frozen title row must beat the frozen bulk row.
           Existing bulk-row CSS uses z-index 9; existing title-row CSS
           uses 10. We bump frozen cells well above both. */
        table.import-table.frozen-left thead tr.bulk-row > :nth-child(-n+5) {
            z-index: 25 !important;
            background: #eff6ff;   /* keep the bulk row's blue tint inside the frozen band */
        }
        table.import-table.frozen-left thead tr#resultsHeaderRow > :nth-child(-n+5) {
            z-index: 30 !important;
        }
        /* Row-selected, issue, and warning backgrounds need to win
           against the frozen band's default backgrounds. We use the
           same compound selectors so the cascade is unambiguous. */
        table.import-table.frozen-left tbody tr.row-selected > :nth-child(-n+5):not(.cell-issue):not(.cell-warning) {
            background: #eff6ff;
        }
        table.import-table.frozen-left tbody tr.row-selected > :nth-child(1) {
            background: #dbeafe;
        }
        table.import-table.frozen-left tbody > tr > .cell-issue   { background: #fef2f2 !important; }
        table.import-table.frozen-left tbody > tr > .cell-warning { background: #fffbeb !important; }
        /* Lock button in the column header — sits next to the column name,
           same visual weight as the remap icon. `active` is when the freeze
           is on. */
        .col-lock-btn {
            background: transparent; border: none; color: #94a3b8; cursor: pointer;
            padding: 1px 2px; border-radius: 3px;
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            margin-left: 4px; vertical-align: middle; line-height: 1;
        }
        .col-lock-btn:hover  { color: var(--color-primary); background: #eff6ff; }
        .col-lock-btn.active { color: var(--color-primary); background: #dbeafe; }
        .col-lock-btn svg    { width: 11px; height: 11px; display: block; }

        /* =====================================================
           COLUMNS PICKER  (toolbar dropdown — hide / show columns)
           ----
           Same look as the existing .filters-popover (reused for visual
           consistency), but holds one checkbox per schema column instead
           of the three "Only Show…" filters. Wired up in showColumnsPopover
           + toggleColumnVisibility below.
           ===================================================== */
        /* .columns-popover family, scrollbar styling, and .text-* /
           .fw-bold / .text-center / .d-block / .hidden utilities all live
           in fb-styles.css now. */

        /* The .app-tooltip family, .toast family + @keyframes toastSlideIn,
           .fb-drawer family + .ds-* in-drawer helpers, .modal-* family,
           .filters-dropdown / .filters-popover, .src-chip, and
           @keyframes spin / .spin all live in fb-styles.css now. */

        /* =====================================================
           DEBUG CONSOLE
           ----
           The old inline-card debug console used to live here. We've
           moved to the shared bottom-drawer pattern in fb-lib — see
           FBLib.Common.mountDebugDrawer(). The drawer brings its own
           CSS, markup, and resize/copy/clear handlers, so the rules
           here have all been removed. The `#debugLog` element id is
           preserved inside the drawer, so existing FBLib.Common.debugLog
           calls keep writing to the correct target without changes.
           ===================================================== */
    </style>
</head>

<!-- ====================================================================
     SETTINGS DRAWER (drop-down from header — standard fb-drawer pattern)
     ==================================================================== -->
<div id="setOverlay" class="fb-drawer">
    <div class="fb-drawer-head">
        <h2>⚙ Configuration Settings</h2>
        <button type="button" class="fb-drawer-close" onclick="PageSettings.closePanel()" aria-label="Close">×</button>
    </div>
    <div class="fb-drawer-body">
        <div id="dsLockBadge" class="ds-lock-badge" style="display:none;">Locked by admin — your changes won't be saved.</div>

        <div class="ds-grid">
            <div class="config-group">
                <h5>Tax region</h5>
                <div class="config-item">
                    <label for="region">Region</label>
                    <select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="region" onchange="onRegionChange()">
                        <option value="auto" selected>Auto-detect from Fishbowl</option>
                        <option value="us">US / Canada</option>
                        <option value="apac">APAC (AU / NZ)</option>
                    </select>
                    <small class="text-muted d-block mt-1">
                        Switches which Fishbowl tax columns appear in mapping / table / export:
                        <br><strong>US / Canada</strong> — Customer <code>TaxRate</code> + <code>TaxExempt</code>, PPVP <code>ProductTaxable</code> (boolean).
                        <br><strong>APAC</strong> — Customer <code>TaxCode</code>, PPVP <code>PartTaxCode</code> + <code>ProductTaxCode</code> (GST/FRE/etc.).
                        <span id="regionResolvedNote" class="d-block" style="margin-top:3px; font-style:italic;"></span>
                    </small>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="config-group">
                <h5>PPVP defaults</h5>
                <div class="config-item">
                    <label for="defaultUOM">Default UOM</label>
                    <select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="defaultUOM" onchange="persistSettings()">
                        <option value="ea" selected>ea (Each)</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
                <div class="config-item">
                    <label for="defaultTaxCode">Default PartTaxCode</label>
                    <select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="defaultTaxCode" onchange="persistSettings()">
                        <option value="NON">NON (Non-Taxable)</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
                <div class="config-item">
                    <label for="defaultWeightUOM">Default Weight UOM</label>
                    <select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="defaultWeightUOM" onchange="persistSettings()">
                        <option value="kg" selected>kg</option>
                        <option value="g">g</option>
                        <option value="lb">lb</option>
                        <option value="oz">oz</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="config-group">
                <h5>Customer defaults</h5>
                <div class="config-item">
                    <label for="defaultCustomerStatus">Default Status</label>
                    <select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="defaultCustomerStatus" onchange="persistSettings()">
                        <option value="Normal" selected>Normal</option>
                        <option value="Preferred">Preferred</option>
                        <option value="Hold Sales">Hold Sales</option>
                        <option value="Hold Shipment">Hold Shipment</option>
                        <option value="Hold All">Hold All</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
                <div class="config-item">
                    <label for="defaultCustomerPriority">Default Priority</label>
                    <select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="defaultCustomerPriority" onchange="persistSettings()">
                        <option value="1-Highest">1-Highest</option>
                        <option value="2-High">2-High</option>
                        <option value="3-Normal" selected>3-Normal</option>
                        <option value="4-Low">4-Low</option>
                        <option value="5-Lowest">5-Lowest</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
                <div class="config-item">
                    <label for="defaultAccountPrefix">Account-number prefix (Customer "Number")</label>
                    <input type="text" class="form-control form-control-sm" id="defaultAccountPrefix" value="SHOP-" placeholder="e.g. SHOP-" onchange="persistSettings()">
                    <small class="text-muted d-block mt-1">Prepended to the source's customer id so Fishbowl reps can see the origin at a glance.</small>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="config-group">
                <h5>Vendor defaults</h5>
                <div class="config-item">
                    <label for="defaultVendorStatus">Default Status</label>
                    <select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="defaultVendorStatus" onchange="persistSettings()">
                        <option value="Normal" selected>Normal</option>
                        <option value="Preferred">Preferred</option>
                        <option value="Hold PO">Hold PO</option>
                        <option value="Hold Receipt">Hold Receipt</option>
                        <option value="Hold All">Hold All</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="config-group">
                <h5>Display</h5>
                <div class="config-item">
                    <div class="form-check">
                        <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="showDebug" onchange="toggleDebugConsole()">
                        <label class="form-check-label" for="showDebug">Show debug console</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="config-item">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" onclick="reloadFishbowlReference()">Reload Fishbowl reference data</button>
                    <small class="text-muted d-block mt-1">Re-queries UOM, tax-code, payment-terms, carrier, ship-terms, salesman + customer-group lists. Run after any of those change in Fishbowl.</small>
                </div>
            </div>

        </div><!-- /.ds-grid -->

        <div id="dsAdminSection" class="ds-admin" style="display:none;">
            <label class="ds-label">Admin</label>
            <button type="button" class="ds-btn ds-btn-admin" onclick="PageSettings.publishMaster()">Publish as default for everyone</button>
            <button type="button" class="ds-btn ds-btn-admin" id="dsLockBtn" onclick="PageSettings.toggleLock()">Lock user editing</button>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="fb-drawer-foot">
        <button type="button" class="ds-btn" onclick="PageSettings.resetToDefaults()">Reset to defaults</button>
        <button type="button" class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary" onclick="PageSettings.closePanel()">Done</button>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ====================================================================
     HELP DRAWER (drop-down from header — standard fb-drawer pattern)
     ==================================================================== -->
<div id="helpOverlay" class="fb-drawer">
    <div class="fb-drawer-head">
        <h2>📖 How to Use Import Builder</h2>
        <button type="button" class="fb-drawer-close" onclick="HelpPanel.close()" aria-label="Close">×</button>
    </div>
    <div class="fb-drawer-body">
        <div class="ds-grid">
            <div class="info-box" style="flex:1 1 280px;">
                <h6 class="fw-bold">1 · Drop a source CSV</h6>
                <p>Drag in an export from your source system:</p>
                <ul>
                    <li><strong>Shopify products export</strong> → builds a Fishbowl PPVP (Part/Product/Vendor Pricing) CSV.</li>
                    <li><strong>Shopify customers export</strong> → builds a Fishbowl Customer CSV.</li>
                    <li>Future: Xero contacts / items.</li>
                </ul>
                <p>The tool guesses the source kind from the header row — you can override it via the dropdown next to the filename.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="info-box" style="flex:1 1 280px;">
                <h6 class="fw-bold">2 · Map fields</h6>
                <p>On first load, a mapping dialog pre-fills the obvious matches (e.g. <em>Variant SKU → PartNumber</em>). Required Fishbowl fields are marked <span class="text-danger fw-bold">*</span>; you can't continue until they're mapped.</p>
                <p>Your saved mappings are remembered per source shape, so the next Shopify-products import auto-applies them.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="info-box" style="flex:1 1 280px;">
                <h6 class="fw-bold">3 · Review and fix</h6>
                <p>The result table shows the Fishbowl-shape rows. Click any cell to edit; vocabulary columns (tax code, payment terms, carriers, ship terms, salesman, customer group) become dropdowns populated from your live Fishbowl data.</p>
                <p><strong>Column overwrite</strong>: the strip below each column header lets you bulk-set every (or just-empty) row in that column — typed value for free-text columns, dropdown pick for vocabulary columns. Apply scope toggles between "All" and "Empty only".</p>
                <p>Mandatory cells with no value get a red wash; the row-status pill on the left switches to <span class="text-warning fw-bold">Issues</span> until cleared.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="info-box" style="flex:1 1 280px;">
                <h6 class="fw-bold">4 · Export</h6>
                <p>Click <strong>Export Fishbowl CSV</strong>. The file uses the canonical Fishbowl column order for the chosen target (Customer / Vendor / PPVP), properly RFC-4180 quoted. Review it in a spreadsheet, then import via Fishbowl's File → Import → Import (or paste-import) UI.</p>
                <p>Direct API push (one-click "create in Fishbowl") is on the roadmap — for v1 we round-trip via CSV for safety.</p>
            </div>
        </div><!-- /.ds-grid -->
        <div class="alert alert-info" style="margin-top:10px;"><strong>Tip:</strong> Settings (gear icon) persist to your Fishbowl user account via <code>FBLib.Settings</code>. Admins can publish them as the default for all users.</div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ====================================================================
     SOURCE DRAWER — opened by the "Source" button in the KPI row.
     Holds source/target chip, Edit mapping, Reset, and a mini drop
     zone for swapping in another CSV. Same .fb-drawer style as the
     Settings + Help drawers above so all three share the slot just

<div id="sourceOverlay" class="fb-drawer">
    <div class="fb-drawer-head">
        <h2>📂 Source & Mapping</h2>
        <button type="button" class="fb-drawer-close" onclick="SourcePanel.close()" aria-label="Close">×</button>
    </div>
    <div class="fb-drawer-body">
        <div style="display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center;">
            <span class="src-chip">
                <span class="src-label">Source:</span>
                <span id="srcKindLabel">—</span>
                <span class="src-label" style="margin-left:8px;">→ Target:</span>
                <select id="targetSelect" onchange="changeTarget(this.value)">

<!-- ====================================================================
     PROCESSING-PROGRESS MODAL — shown by ProcessingOverlay.show() while
     processRows() chunks through the source CSV. Non-dismissible (no
     close button / backdrop click) because the work is mid-flight.
     ==================================================================== -->
<div id="processingModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-card" style="max-width:380px; padding:0;">
        <div style="padding:24px 24px 18px; text-align:center;">
            <div class="spin" id="processingSpinner"
                 style="width:36px;height:36px;border:3px solid #e2e8f0;border-top-color:var(--color-primary);border-radius:50%;margin:0 auto 16px;"></div>
            <h3 id="processingTitle" style="margin:0; font-size:14px; color:#0f172a;">Processing rows…</h3>
            <p id="processingMsg" style="color:#64748b; font-size:12px; margin:6px 0 0;">Preparing…</p>
            <div style="background:#e2e8f0; border-radius:999px; height:6px; margin-top:14px; overflow:hidden;">
                <div id="processingBar" style="background:var(--color-primary); height:100%; width:0%; transition:width 0.15s ease;"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ====================================================================
     GENERIC CONFIRM MODAL — populated + shown by showConfirm({...}).
     Hidden by default; ESC + backdrop-click cancel, Enter confirms.
     ==================================================================== -->
<div id="confirmModal" class="modal-overlay" onclick="ConfirmModal.closeIfOverlay(event)">
    <div class="modal-card" style="max-width:440px;" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
        <div class="modal-head">
            <h3 id="confirmTitle">Confirm</h3>
            <button type="button" class="ds-close" onclick="ConfirmModal.cancel()">×</button>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-body" id="confirmBody" style="font-size:13px; color:#334155; line-height:1.5;"></div>
        <div class="modal-foot">

<script>
// ============================================================================
// SHARED LIB HOOKS — prefer FBLib.Common / FBLib.Settings, with local fallbacks
// so the page still works if fb-lib is absent or stale.
// ============================================================================
var _C = (window.FBLib && FBLib.Common) ? FBLib.Common : null;

// Handle returned by FBLib.Common.mountDebugDrawer() once init() runs.
// Used by toggleDebugConsole() to show/hide the drawer in response to the
// "Show Debug Console" checkbox. Declared up-front so the forwarder
// functions defined below can reference it before init() runs.
var _drawerApi = null;

// Lazily mount the bottom-drawer debug console. Idempotent — fb-lib's
// mountDebugDrawer guards on its own _drawerMounted flag, so re-calling
// is a no-op that just returns the cached api. We try to mount here on
// every entry point that might need the drawer (init, toggleDebugConsole)
// so we don't depend on a particular call order or on fb-lib having
// loaded by the time the module-init IIFE runs.
// ----
// If fb-lib is absent or its installed copy is older than the one that
// shipped `mountDebugDrawer`, we fall back to an inline-mounted drawer
// with the same `.fblib-debug-drawer` class names so the rest of the
// page's drawer-height observer keeps working. The fallback uses the
// SAME element id (`fbLibDebugDrawer`) so a later fb-lib hot-reload is a
// no-op (mountDebugDrawer's _drawerMounted guard sees our element and
// reuses it).
function _ensureDrawer() {
    if (_drawerApi) return _drawerApi;
    if (!_C) _C = (window.FBLib && FBLib.Common) ? FBLib.Common : null;
    if (_C && typeof _C.mountDebugDrawer === 'function') {
        try { _drawerApi = _C.mountDebugDrawer(); } catch (e) { console.error('[Import Builder] fb-lib mountDebugDrawer threw', e); }
    }
    if (!_drawerApi) {
        console.warn('[Import Builder] fb-lib debug drawer unavailable — mounting inline fallback. Re-save the fb-lib Script in Fishbowl to pick up the canonical drawer.');
        _drawerApi = _mountInlineDebugDrawer();
    }
    return _drawerApi;
}

// Inline fallback. Same CSS class names + same #debugLog id as fb-lib's
// drawer so debugLog() can write through and so the ResizeObserver in
// _observeDebugDrawer() picks up height changes uniformly.
function _mountInlineDebugDrawer() {
    if (document.getElementById('fbLibDebugDrawer')) {
        return _buildLocalDrawerApi(document.getElementById('fbLibDebugDrawer'));
    }
    if (!document.getElementById('fbLibFallbackDrawerStyle')) {
        var style = document.createElement('style');
        style.id = 'fbLibFallbackDrawerStyle';
        style.textContent =
            '.fblib-debug-drawer{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:9000;' +
                "font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;background:transparent;display:none}" +
            '.fblib-debug-drawer.is-visible{display:block}' +
            '.fblib-debug-drawer .fblib-debug-resize{height:6px;cursor:ns-resize;border-top:2px solid #e2e8f0;background:#f1f5f9}' +
            '.fblib-debug-drawer .fblib-debug-shell{background:#fff;box-shadow:0 -4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}' +
            '.fblib-debug-drawer .fblib-debug-toggle{width:100%;padding:8px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;color:#475569;font-weight:600}' +
            '.fblib-debug-drawer .fblib-debug-content{display:none;border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0;background:#fff}' +
            '.fblib-debug-drawer.is-open .fblib-debug-content{display:block}' +
            '.fblib-debug-drawer #debugLog{background:#0f172a;color:#e2e8f0;padding:10px 14px;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:11px;height:200px;overflow-y:auto;line-height:1.5;white-space:pre-wrap}';
        document.head.appendChild(style);
    }
    var el = document.createElement('div');
    el.id = 'fbLibDebugDrawer';
    el.className = 'fblib-debug-drawer';
    el.innerHTML =
        '<div class="fblib-debug-resize" title="Drag to resize"></div>' +
        '<div class="fblib-debug-shell">' +
            '<button type="button" class="fblib-debug-toggle">' +
                '<span>Debug Console (fallback — fb-lib not loaded)</span>' +
                '<span style="color:#94a3b8;">▾</span>' +
            '</button>' +
            '<div class="fblib-debug-content">' +
                '<div id="debugLog"><span style="color:#475569;font-style:italic;">Waiting for log entries…</span></div>' +
            '</div>' +
        '</div>';
    document.body.appendChild(el);
    // Header click toggles expand/collapse.
    el.querySelector('.fblib-debug-toggle').addEventListener('click', function () {
        el.classList.toggle('is-open');
    });
    // Drag-to-resize the inner log element (mirrors fb-lib's behaviour).
    var handle = el.querySelector('.fblib-debug-resize');
    var logEl = el.querySelector('#debugLog');
    var resizing = false, startY = 0, startH = 0;
    handle.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) {
        resizing = true; startY = e.clientY; startH = logEl.offsetHeight;
        document.body.style.userSelect = 'none'; e.preventDefault();
    });
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) {
        if (!resizing) return;
        var delta = startY - e.clientY;
        var maxH = Math.floor(window.innerHeight * 0.7);
        logEl.style.height = Math.max(80, Math.min(maxH, startH + delta)) + 'px';
    });
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', function () {
        if (resizing) { resizing = false; document.body.style.userSelect = ''; }
    });
    return _buildLocalDrawerApi(el);
}
function _buildLocalDrawerApi(el) {
    return {
        show:      function () { el.classList.add('is-visible'); },
        hide:      function () { el.classList.remove('is-visible'); },
        toggle:    function () { el.classList.toggle('is-visible'); },
        expand:    function () { el.classList.add('is-open'); el.classList.add('is-visible'); },
        collapse:  function () { el.classList.remove('is-open'); },
        isOpen:    function () { return el.classList.contains('is-open'); },
        isVisible: function () { return el.classList.contains('is-visible'); },
        element:   el
    };
}

// Track the live drawer height as a CSS variable on <body> so the
// `padding-bottom: var(--debug-drawer-h)` rule keeps the results table
// from being covered. Watches BOTH classList changes (show/hide,
// expand/collapse) AND content resize (user drags the resize handle).
// One ResizeObserver + one MutationObserver per page — both idempotent
// via the `_observed` flag.
function _observeDebugDrawer(el) {
    if (!el || el._observed) return;
    el._observed = true;
    var apply = function () {
        var visible = el.classList.contains('is-visible');
        var open    = el.classList.contains('is-open');
        var h = (visible && open) ? Math.ceil(el.getBoundingClientRect().height) : (visible ? 40 : 0);
        document.body.style.setProperty('--debug-drawer-h', h + 'px');
    };
    apply();
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') {
        try { new ResizeObserver(apply).observe(el); } catch (_) {}
    } else {
        // Fallback for ancient environments: poll every 250ms while the
        // drawer is visible. Cheap because it's just a getBoundingClientRect.
        setInterval(function () {
            if (el.classList.contains('is-visible')) apply();
        }, 250);
    }
    try {
        new MutationObserver(apply).observe(el, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
    } catch (_) {}
}

// DEBUG_MODE is driven solely by the user's persisted "Show debug
// console" setting. We deliberately do NOT fall back to the
// `BI_SHOW_DEBUG` system property — that property used to act as a
// silent, per-server override; with the drawer + checkbox it's
// redundant and confusing (a user who unticks the box still saw the
// drawer reappear on reload because the property was true).
//
// FBLib.Settings.init() is called immediately below, so by the time
// the init() IIFE at the bottom of this script reads this value, the
// resolver is hot. The initial computation here may return false
// before settings are initialised, but init() recomputes it via
// `_resolve('showDebug', false)` so the persisted value wins.
var DEBUG_MODE = (function () {
    try {
        if (_C && typeof _C.DEBUG_MODE !== 'undefined') return !!_C.DEBUG_MODE;
    } catch (e) {}
    return false;
})();

try {
    if (window.FBLib && FBLib.Settings) {
        FBLib.Settings.init({
            masterStorage: 'userProperties',   // shared admin defaults via userproperties, not report data (which needs a SAVED report — see FBLib.SharedData)
            userKey:   'cdx.bi.importBuilder.user.v1',
            masterKey: 'cdx.bi.importBuilder.master.v1',
            defaults: {
                v: 1,
                defaultUOM: 'ea',
                defaultTaxCode: 'NON',
                defaultWeightUOM: 'kg',
                defaultCustomerStatus: 'Normal',
                defaultCustomerPriority: '3-Normal',
                defaultVendorStatus: 'Normal',
                defaultAccountPrefix: 'SHOP-',
                // Tax-column region. 'auto' = infer from Fishbowl's home
                // currency locale (en-AU/en-NZ → apac; en-US/en-CA → us);
                // 'us' / 'apac' force a specific behaviour. Drives which
                // tax columns appear in mapping/table/export — see
                // _visibleColumns() and the schema columns flagged with
                // `regions: [...]`.
                region: 'auto',
                mappings: {},   // keyed by `${sourceId}|${targetKind}`
                showDebug: false
            },
            propFallback: { showDebug: { name: 'BI_SHOW_DEBUG', dflt: 'false', parse: function (v) { return v === 'true' || v === true; } } }
        });
    }
} catch (e) { /* settings bridge unavailable */ }

function _settingsReady() { return !!(window.FBLib && FBLib.Settings); }

//    el.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) { showAppTooltip(e, {...same}); });
//    el.addEventListener('mouseout',  hideAppTooltip);

// re-triggering the delay.

var _tooltipTimer = null;

// keep updating "what to show" on every mousemove without restarting the

// to reset forever and the tooltip to never appear).

    // is `fixed`, so coords are viewport-relative — no scroll offset needed.
    var vw = window.innerWidth;
    var vh = window.innerHeight;
    var ax = (x + tw + 15 > vw) ? Math.max(12, x - tw - 15) : x + 15;

                '</span>';
    }
    if (payload.desc) {
        html += '<span class="tt-desc">' + escapeHtml(payload.desc) + '</span>';

    // reveal uses the freshest cursor coords.

        el.innerHTML = html;

    // implementation cleared and reset the timer on every mousemove,
    // which meant the 400ms delay never elapsed and the tooltip never
    // appeared — which is what the user saw as "rich tooltips don't work,
    // only OS-native ones show up after the Windows delay".
    if (_tooltipTimer) return;

// DELEGATED TOOLTIP — any element with data-tt-title / data-tt-desc /
// data-tt-meta / data-tt-required gets the rich popover automatically.
// Means new affordances (status pills, cell-issues, bulk-overwrite controls)
// can opt in by setting attributes — no per-element listener wiring.
// ============================================================================
function _findTooltipHost(el) {
    while (el && el !== document.body && el.nodeType === 1) {
        var ds = el.dataset;
        if (ds && (ds.ttTitle || ds.ttDesc || ds.ttMeta)) return el;
        el = el.parentElement;
    }
    return null;
}
function _payloadFromHost(host) {
    var ds = host.dataset;
    return {
        title:    ds.ttTitle || '',
        desc:     ds.ttDesc  || '',
        meta:     ds.ttMeta  || '',

// Deferred-hide window — when leaving a tt-host, we wait ~80ms before
// actually hiding so that immediately mousing into ANOTHER tt-host can
// cancel the hide and just swap content. Without this, every cell-to-cell
// move would force a fresh 400ms wait, which reads as broken UX on a body
// of 5000 errored cells.
var _ttHideTimer = null;

    var host = _findTooltipHost(e.target);
    if (!host) return;
    if (_ttHideTimer) { clearTimeout(_ttHideTimer); _ttHideTimer = null; }
    // Moving INTO the same active host (e.g. between its children) — no-op.
    if (host === _tooltipActiveHost) return;

    // showAppTooltip's "already visible" branch swaps content instantly.
    _tooltipActiveHost = host;

document.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) {

    // if still in the delay window, the eventual reveal uses fresh coords.

    var to = e.relatedTarget;

    // it and just swap content (see the mouseover handler above).

// Strip HTML tags from a string (Body (HTML) → plain text). Keeps line breaks
// where the tag was a <br> or <p> so descriptions stay readable.
function stripHtml(s) {
    if (s == null) return '';
    var str = String(s);
    str = str.replace(/<\s*br\s*\/?\s*>/gi, '\n');
    str = str.replace(/<\s*\/p\s*>/gi, '\n');
    str = str.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '');
    str = str.replace(/ /gi, ' ').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/'/g, "'");

// ============================================================================
function parseCSVLine(line) {

    for (var i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
        var ch = line[i], next = line[i + 1];
        if (inQuotes) {

            else if (ch === '"') { inQuotes = false; }
            else { current += ch; }
        } else {
            if (ch === '"') inQuotes = true;
            else if (ch === ',') { result.push(current); current = ''; }
            else current += ch;
        }

// RFC-4180 CSV parser. The previous implementation split on '\n' before
// parsing fields — that breaks on real-world Shopify product exports,
// where the `Body (HTML)` column legitimately contains newlines inside a
// quoted field. A single logical record was getting shredded into ~15
// pseudo-rows, all but the first with an empty SKU, which then got skipped
// — producing totals like "107 valid / 3187 skipped" for what was actually
// a 208-record file.
//
// This version walks the text once with a small state machine, so a
// newline inside a quoted field stays inside the field. `_sourceRowNum`
// is the RECORD index (1 = header, 2 = first data row, ...), which matches
// the row numbers a user sees in Excel / Google Sheets opening the same
// file.
function parseCSV(text) {
    if (text == null) return { headers: [], rows: [] };
    var s = String(text);
    // Strip a leading BOM. Shopify and a few other exporters emit one.
    if (s.charCodeAt(0) === 0xFEFF) s = s.slice(1);

    var records = [];
    var current = [];
    var field = '';
    var inQuotes = false;

    for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
        var ch = s.charAt(i);
        if (inQuotes) {
            if (ch === '"') {
                // Escaped double-quote ("") -> literal "
                if (s.charAt(i + 1) === '"') { field += '"'; i++; }
                else { inQuotes = false; }
            } else {
                // Inside quotes — newlines belong to the field, NOT a record break.
                field += ch;
            }
        } else {
            if (ch === '"') {
                inQuotes = true;
            } else if (ch === ',') {
                current.push(field); field = '';
            } else if (ch === '\r') {
                // Treat \r\n as one record break (handled by \n branch).
                if (s.charAt(i + 1) === '\n') continue;
                current.push(field); records.push(current); current = []; field = '';
            } else if (ch === '\n') {
                current.push(field); records.push(current); current = []; field = '';
            } else {
                field += ch;
            }
        }
    }
    // Flush any trailing field / record (file without final newline).
    if (field !== '' || current.length) {
        current.push(field);
        records.push(current);
    }
    // Drop wholly-empty records (final blank line after the last newline).
    records = records.filter(function (r) {
        return r.some(function (v) { return v !== ''; });
    });

    if (!records.length) return { headers: [], rows: [] };
    var headers = records[0].map(function (h) { return h.trim(); });
    var rows = [];
    for (var r = 1; r < records.length; r++) {
        var vals = records[r];
        // _sourceRowNum is 1-indexed record number — record 1 is the header,
        // so the first data row reads as `2`. Matches Excel's row numbering.
        var row = { _sourceRowNum: r + 1 };
        headers.forEach(function (h, idx) {
            var v = vals[idx] !== undefined ? vals[idx] : '';

            // time. Real-world CSV exports routinely contain stray
            // padding (Shopify pads some columns to a fixed width; users
            // paste-built CSVs gather trailing tabs). Trimming up-front
            // means downstream validation, vocab matching, and dedup all
            // see the canonical form — without it, "GST " ≠ "GST" and
            // every cell goes through a hidden Unknown-value flag.
            // Trim BEFORE stripLeadingQuote so a " 'TAPIAC" still has its
            // Excel-defeating apostrophe correctly stripped.
            row[h] = stripLeadingQuote(String(v).trim());
        });
        rows.push(row);
    }
    return { headers: headers, rows: rows };
}

function loadFishbowlReference() {
    if (typeof runQuery !== 'function') {
        debugLog('runQuery unavailable — reference vocabularies will fall back to free-text inputs.', 'warn');
        return;
    }
    function fetchList(label, sql, mapper, store) {
        try {
            var res = runQuery(sql);
            if (!res) { debugLog(label + ': empty result', 'warn'); return; }
            var rows = JSON.parse(res);
            if (rows && !Array.isArray(rows)) rows = [rows];
            store(rows.map(mapper), rows);
            debugLog('Loaded ' + refData[label].length + ' ' + label, 'success');
        } catch (e) {
            debugLog(label + ' query failed: ' + e.message, 'error');
        }
    }
    fetchList('uoms',
        'SELECT code, name, uomtype FROM uom WHERE activeflag = 1 ORDER BY code',
        function (u) { return u.code; },
        function (list, rows) { refData.uoms = list; refData.uomDetails = rows; });
    // UOM conversion set — codes that appear on at least one row of
    // `uomconversion` as either source or target. Anything in `uom` but
    // NOT in this set is flagged by validateRow with kind 'missing-uom-
    // conversion' so the user can add the conversion before importing.
    try {
        var convRes = runQuery(
            'SELECT DISTINCT u.code AS code FROM uom u ' +
            'WHERE u.activeflag = 1 AND (' +
            '  u.id IN (SELECT fromUomId FROM uomconversion) OR ' +
            '  u.id IN (SELECT toUomId   FROM uomconversion)' +
            ')'
        );
        if (convRes) {
            var convRows = JSON.parse(convRes);
            if (convRows && !Array.isArray(convRows)) convRows = [convRows];
            refData.uomConversionCodes = new Set(convRows.map(function (r) { return r.code; }));
            debugLog('Loaded ' + refData.uomConversionCodes.size + ' UOMs with conversion entries', 'success');
        }
    } catch (e) {
        debugLog('uomconversion query failed: ' + e.message, 'error');
    }
    fetchList('taxCodes',
        'SELECT code, name FROM taxrate WHERE activeflag = 1 ORDER BY code',
        function (t) { return t.code; },
        function (list, rows) { refData.taxCodes = list; refData.taxCodeDetails = rows; });
    fetchList('paymentTerms',
        'SELECT name FROM paymentterms WHERE activeflag = 1 ORDER BY name',
        function (p) { return p.name; },
        function (list) { refData.paymentTerms = list; });
    fetchList('carriers',
        'SELECT name FROM carrier WHERE activeflag = 1 ORDER BY name',
        function (c) { return c.name; },
        function (list) { refData.carriers = list; });
    fetchList('carrierServices',
        'SELECT name FROM carrierservice WHERE activeflag = 1 ORDER BY name',
        function (c) { return c.name; },
        function (list) { refData.carrierServices = list; });
    fetchList('shipTerms',
        'SELECT name FROM shipterms WHERE activeflag = 1 ORDER BY name',
        function (s) { return s.name; },
        function (list) { refData.shipTerms = list; });
    fetchList('salesmen',
        'SELECT username AS name FROM sysuser WHERE activeflag = 1 ORDER BY username',
        function (s) { return s.name; },
        function (list) { refData.salesmen = list; });
    fetchList('customerGroups',
        'SELECT name FROM accountgroup ORDER BY name',
        function (g) { return g.name; },
        function (list) { refData.customerGroups = list; });
    fetchList('currencies',
        'SELECT name FROM currency ORDER BY name',
        function (c) { return c.name; },
        function (list) { refData.currencies = list; });
    fetchList('countries',
        'SELECT code, name FROM countryconst ORDER BY name',
        function (c) { return c.code; },
        function (list, rows) { refData.countries = list; refData.countryDetails = rows; });
    fetchList('existingCustomers',
        'SELECT name FROM customer WHERE activeflag = 1',
        function (c) { return c.name; },
        function (list) { refData.existingCustomers = list; });
    fetchList('existingVendors',
        'SELECT name FROM vendor WHERE activeflag = 1',
        function (v) { return v.name; },
        function (list) { refData.existingVendors = list; });

    populateSettingsDropdowns();

// Lookup helper — given a schema column's vocab spec, return an array of
// { value, label } pairs ready to render in a <select>. ENUM specs reference
// the ENUMS table; tax codes use the richer `taxCodeDetails` so the dropdown
// shows e.g. "GST - Goods and Services Tax" instead of just "GST"; everything
// else points at a flat refData list of string codes.
//
// The exported VALUE stays as the code alone (Fishbowl's import expects the
// short code, not the name), but the visible LABEL is decorated so reps can
// pick the right entry without having to memorise codes.
function vocabOptions(vocab) {
    if (!vocab) return null;
    if (vocab.indexOf('ENUM:') === 0) {
        var key = vocab.slice(5);
        var arr = ENUMS[key];
        if (!arr) return null;
        return arr.map(function (v) {
            return (typeof v === 'string') ? { value: v, label: v } : v;
        });
    }
    // Tax codes — decorate with the human-readable name from
    // refData.taxCodeDetails so the dropdown reads "GST - Goods and
    // Services Tax" rather than just "GST". Value stays as the bare code
    // (Fishbowl's import column expects the code, not the name).
    if (vocab === 'taxCodes' && refData.taxCodeDetails && refData.taxCodeDetails.length) {
        return refData.taxCodeDetails.map(function (t) {
            var name = t.name && t.name !== t.code ? ' - ' + t.name : '';
            return { value: t.code, label: t.code + name };
        });
    }
    var list = refData[vocab];
    if (!list || !list.length) return null;
    return list.map(function (v) { return { value: v, label: v }; });
}
