// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Helpers shared by the three Fishbowl-canonical profiles above. Kept
// outside the SOURCE_PROFILES array so each profile's literal stays
// readable. The behaviour is identical across vendor/customer/PPVP — the
// only difference is which target schema is active when these run, which
// is read from ctx + state at call time.
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Identity-map every Fishbowl-target column to the same-named source column
// when that column exists in the CSV. Lets the user drop a Fishbowl-shape
// CSV and see every column pre-mapped without touching the mapping modal.
// `targetCols` is the visible-in-region column list, so region-hidden
// columns (e.g. PPVP PartTaxCode in US mode) don't get auto-mapped to
// themselves and then ignored at export time.
function _fbCanonicalIdentityMap(srcHeaders, targetCols) {
    var map = {};
    var srcSet = {};
    srcHeaders.forEach(function (h) { srcSet[h] = true; });
    (targetCols || []).forEach(function (col) {
        if (srcSet[col.key]) map[col.key] = col.key;
    });
    return map;
}

// Near-pass-through transform: copy every mapped source value as-is, then
// fill any blank required column with its schema-appropriate default.
// We deliberately DON'T overwrite anything the source provided — a Fishbowl
// CSV is the canonical source of truth for itself.
function _fbCanonicalPassThrough(src, ctx, mapping) {
    var out = {};
    Object.keys(mapping).forEach(function (fbField) {
        var v = _mappedValue(src, mapping[fbField]);
        if (v == null || v === '') return;
        out[fbField] = v;
    });
    // Minimal defaults so the row passes validation. Each target picks its
    // own appropriate column to fill — gated to ctx-known target kind.
    var t = state.targetKind;
    if (t === 'vendor') {
        if (!out.Status) out.Status = ctx.defaults.defaultVendorStatus || 'Normal';
        if (!out.Active) out.Active = 'true';
        if (!out.AddressType) out.AddressType = '50';
        if (!out.IsDefault) out.IsDefault = 'true';
    } else if (t === 'customer') {
        if (!out.Status) out.Status = ctx.defaults.defaultCustomerStatus || 'Normal';
        if (!out['Default Priority']) out['Default Priority'] = ctx.defaults.defaultCustomerPriority || '3-Normal';
        if (!out.Active) out.Active = 'true';
        if (!out.AddressType) out.AddressType = '50';
        if (!out.IsDefault) out.IsDefault = 'true';
    } else if (t === 'ppvp') {
        if (!out.PartTypeID) out.PartTypeID = '10';
        if (!out.Active) out.Active = 'true';
        if (!out.UOM) out.UOM = ctx.defaults.defaultUOM || 'ea';
        if (!out.PartTaxCode) out.PartTaxCode = ctx.defaults.defaultTaxCode || 'NON';
    }
    // Identity check — if the source row had no Name / PartNumber, skip it
    // (mirrors the shopify-customers behaviour where unidentifiable rows
    // are dropped rather than passed through).
    var idCol = (t === 'ppvp') ? 'PartNumber' : 'Name';
    if (!out[idCol] || !String(out[idCol]).trim()) {
        return { _skip: true, reason: 'Row ' + src._sourceRowNum + ' has no ' + idCol };
    }
    return out;
}

function detectSourceProfile(headers) {
    var best = null, bestScore = 0;
    SOURCE_PROFILES.forEach(function (p) {
        var s = p.match(headers);
        if (s > bestScore) { bestScore = s; best = p; }
    });
    if (bestScore < 3) return null;   // Too uncertain to guess.
    return best;
}

// ============================================================================
// AUTO-MATCH SCORE  (lifted + adapted from Solidworks_BOM_Converter.htm)
// Per-pair scoring + best-pick to avoid the "Vendor Number" steals "Number"
// class of bug.
// ============================================================================
function autoMatchScore(fishbowlField, sourceColumn, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    var fb = String(fishbowlField).toLowerCase().trim();
    var sw = String(sourceColumn).toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!sw) return 0;
    if (fb === sw) return 1000;

    // Keyword lists are intentionally specific (no bare tokens like "tax" /
    // "status" / "active") to prevent cross-field false positives — e.g.
    // "tax" used to match "Tax Exempt" which then poisoned TaxRate with
    // yes/no values. Each keyword should be specific enough that it can
    // ONLY plausibly belong to its target field.
    var keywordMap = {
        'name': ['company name', 'customer name', 'vendor name', 'supplier name'],
        'addresscontact': ['contact', 'first name', 'attention'],
        'address': ['street address', 'address1', 'address line 1'],
        'city': ['city', 'suburb'],
        'state': ['state', 'province', 'region'],
        'zip': ['zip', 'postcode', 'postal code'],
        'country': ['country'],
        'email': ['email'],
        'main': ['main phone'],
        'mobile': ['mobile', 'cell phone', 'cellphone'],
        'fax': ['fax'],
        'web': ['website'],
        'group': ['customer group', 'tags', 'segment'],
        'number': ['account number', 'customer id', 'vendor id', 'shopify id'],
        'partnumber': ['part number', 'variant sku'],
        'partdescription': ['part description', 'product title'],
        'partdetails': ['part details', 'body (html)'],
        'upc': ['upc', 'barcode', 'variant barcode', 'ean'],
        'uom': ['unit of measure', 'uom'],
        'weight': ['variant grams', 'weight (kg)', 'weight (g)'],
        'weightuom': ['weight unit', 'weight uom'],
        'price': ['variant price', 'sell price', 'retail price'],
        'cost': ['cost per item', 'unit cost'],
        'stdcost': ['standard cost', 'std cost'],
        'vendor': ['supplier', 'manufacturer'],
        'parttaxcode': ['tax code', 'variant tax code'],
        'producttaxcode': ['product tax code', 'tax code', 'variant tax code'],
        'taxcode': ['tax code', 'customer tax code'],
        'producttaxable': ['variant taxable', 'taxable'],
        'productpictureurl': ['image src', 'image url'],
        'partpictureurl': ['image src', 'image url'],
        'active': ['active'],
        'productactive': ['active'],
        'productdescription': ['product description', 'product title'],
        'productnumber': ['product sku', 'variant sku'],
        'productsku': ['variant sku', 'product sku'],
        'productupc': ['upc', 'barcode'],
        'taxexempt': ['tax exempt'],
        'alertnotes': ['notes', 'note', 'alert notes'],
        'addresstype': ['address type'],
        'paymentterms': ['payment terms'],
        'carriername': ['carrier name', 'carrier'],
        'shippingterms': ['shipping terms', 'shipterms'],
        'taxrate': ['tax rate']   // intentionally NOT 'tax' — see comment above
    };
    var kws = keywordMap[fb] || [fb];

    // Strict mode is used for vocab-controlled Fishbowl fields (TaxRate,
    // PaymentTerms, Group, Salesman, etc.). For those, a fuzzy substring
    // match is dangerous: the source column may contain values that don't
    // exist in the live Fishbowl reference list, so the cell renders
    // blank-looking with a hidden "Unknown value" issue. Better to leave
    // those fields unmapped and let the user pick them by hand.
    var best = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < kws.length; i++) {
        var k = kws[i];
        if (sw === k) best = Math.max(best, 900);
        else if (!opts.strict && sw.indexOf(k) !== -1) {
            // Use word-boundary regex when the keyword is short (≤4 chars)
            // so e.g. "tax" doesn't match "tax exempt" via raw substring.
            if (k.length > 4) best = Math.max(best, 100 + k.length);
            else {
                var rx = new RegExp('(^|\\W)' + k.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\\]\\\\]/g, '\\$&') + '($|\\W)');
                if (rx.test(sw)) best = Math.max(best, 100 + k.length);
            }
        }
    }
    return best;
}

// Resolve the active tax region. 'us' / 'apac' from the user setting; on
// 'auto', infer from Fishbowl's home-company locale. Defaults to 'us' when
// unrecognised — the safer fallback because the US Taxable boolean is a
// strict subset of an APAC tax-code's expressiveness (a US user mistakenly
// shown the boolean still gets a valid CSV; an APAC user shown the boolean
// would silently lose the tax-code data).
function detectRegion() {
    var setting = _resolve('region', 'auto');
    if (setting === 'us' || setting === 'apac') return setting;
    try {
        if (typeof currencyLocale === 'function') {
            var info = currencyLocale() || {};
            var locale = String(info.locale || '').toLowerCase();
            if (/^en[-_](au|nz)\b/.test(locale)) return 'apac';
            if (/^en[-_](us|ca)\b/.test(locale)) return 'us';
            // Some installs surface only the currency code in `.symbol`.
            var sym = String(info.symbol || '').toUpperCase();
            if (sym === 'AUD' || sym === 'NZD') return 'apac';
            if (sym === 'USD' || sym === 'CAD') return 'us';
        }
    } catch (e) { debugLog('Region auto-detect failed: ' + e.message, 'warn'); }
    return 'us';
}

// True when `col` should be rendered/validated/exported in the current
// region. Columns without an explicit `regions` list apply everywhere.
function _columnVisible(col) {
    if (!col || !col.regions) return true;
    return col.regions.indexOf(state.activeRegion) !== -1;
}

// Region-filtered view of a schema's columns. Use this in every iteration
// site that drives display / validation / export. Definition LOOKUPS
// (find-by-key) should still use schema.columns directly so a lookup never
// returns null just because the column is hidden in the current region.
// ----
// `_visibleColumns(schema)`           — region + user-hidden filtered (for table render)
// `_visibleColumns(schema, true)`     — region only, ignores user hides (for validation + export)
//
// Validation, export, and the Columns picker itself MUST pass true so
// they see every region-applicable column regardless of whether the user
// chose to hide it on screen — hiding is a display preference, not a
// data filter.
function _visibleColumns(schema, ignoreHides) {
    if (!schema || !schema.columns) return [];
    var cols = schema.columns.filter(_columnVisible);
    if (ignoreHides) return cols;
    if (!state.hiddenCols || !state.hiddenCols.size) return cols;
    return cols.filter(function (c) { return !state.hiddenCols.has(c.key); });
}

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MAPPING ENTRY SHAPE
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// state.fieldMappings[fbField] can be one of three shapes:
//   - ''            (unmapped)
//   - 'ColA'        (single source column, the original shape)
//   - ['ColA','ColB']  (concatenate two source columns with a space)
// The single-string shape is preserved for backwards-compat with mappings
// saved before concat support (and to keep the wire format short). Every
// reader goes through _mappingCols / _mappedValue below so the rest of the
// code never has to branch on shape.
function _mappingCols(mapping) {
    if (!mapping) return [];
    if (Array.isArray(mapping)) return mapping.filter(Boolean);
    return [String(mapping)];
}

// Resolve a mapping against a source row. Concatenates with a single space
// when there are 2+ columns; drops empty individual values from the join so
// "John  Smith" never appears just because the middle col is blank.
// Returns undefined when nothing usable was found, so the caller can skip
// writing rather than writing an empty string.
function _mappedValue(srcRow, mapping) {
    var cols = _mappingCols(mapping);
    if (!cols.length) return undefined;
    var parts = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) {
        var v = srcRow[cols[i]];
        if (v == null) continue;
        var s = String(v);
        if (s.trim() === '') continue;
        parts.push(s);
    }
    if (!parts.length) return undefined;
    return parts.join(' ');
}

// ============================================================================
// FILE INGEST + DRAG-DROP
// ----
// Two drop zones share the same handlers:
//   - #uploadHero — full-width pre-file affordance
//   - #uploadSectionMini — compact zone inside #sourceOverlay drawer (post-file)
// Both call processFile(). The hidden #fileInput is a single shared element
// outside both — `.click()` on it from either drop-zone's Choose button.
// ============================================================================
(function setupDragDrop() {
    ['uploadHero', 'uploadSectionMini'].forEach(function (id) {
        var sec = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!sec) return;
        sec.addEventListener('dragover',  function (e) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); sec.classList.add('dragover'); });
        sec.addEventListener('dragleave', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); sec.classList.remove('dragover'); });
        sec.addEventListener('drop',      function (e) {
            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
            sec.classList.remove('dragover');
            var files = e.dataTransfer.files;
            if (files && files.length && /\.csv$/i.test(files[0].name)) processFile(files[0]);
            else showMessage('Please drop a .csv file', 'danger');
        });
    });
})();

function handleFileSelect(e) {

function processFile(file) {
    state.sourceFile = file;
    document.getElementById('fileName').textContent = file.name;
    var reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function (ev) {
        try {
            var parsed = parseCSV(ev.target.result);
            state.sourceHeaders = parsed.headers;
            state.sourceRows = parsed.rows;
            debugLog('Parsed ' + parsed.rows.length + ' rows × ' + parsed.headers.length + ' cols from ' + file.name, 'success');
            onSourceLoaded();
        } catch (err) {
            debugLog('CSV parse failed: ' + err.message, 'error');
            showMessage('Could not parse CSV: ' + err.message, 'danger');

function onSourceLoaded() {
    var profile = detectSourceProfile(state.sourceHeaders);

    // drawer (chip / mapping / mini drop-zone) stays CLOSED on
    // import — the user just loaded a file, their attention belongs
    // on the results table; the "Source" button beside the KPI tiles
    // opens the drawer if they need it.
    var hero = document.getElementById('uploadHero');

        state.sourceRows.length + ' rows · ' + state.sourceHeaders.length + ' columns · ' +

// ============================================================================
// CONFIRM MODAL — promise-returning gate for destructive actions.
// Usage: ConfirmModal.show({ title, body, okLabel, cancelLabel, danger })
//   .then(ok => { if (ok) ... });
// Cancel sources resolve as `false`: Cancel button, X, backdrop click, Esc.
// Confirm sources resolve as `true`: OK button, Enter key.
// ============================================================================
var ConfirmModal = (function () {
    var _resolver = null;
    var _keyHandler = null;

    function show(opts) {
        opts = opts || {};
        document.getElementById('confirmTitle').textContent = opts.title || 'Confirm';
        // body is HTML so callers can pass a styled fragment; escape any
        // user-supplied content at the callsite.
        document.getElementById('confirmBody').innerHTML = opts.body || '';
        var okBtn = document.getElementById('confirmOkBtn');
        okBtn.textContent = opts.okLabel || 'Confirm';
        // Danger flag styles the confirm button red so the user sees it's
        // destructive before clicking.
        okBtn.className = 'btn btn-sm ' + (opts.danger ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-primary');
        if (opts.danger) {
            okBtn.style.background = '#dc2626';
            okBtn.style.borderColor = '#dc2626';
        } else {
            okBtn.style.background = '';
            okBtn.style.borderColor = '';
        }
        document.getElementById('confirmCancelBtn').textContent = opts.cancelLabel || 'Cancel';

        document.getElementById('confirmModal').classList.add('open');
        // Focus the OK button after the animation so Enter immediately works
        // and screen-readers announce the dialog.
        setTimeout(function () { okBtn.focus(); }, 20);

        // Esc cancels, Enter confirms. One listener per show; removed on close.
        _keyHandler = function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); cancel(); }
            else if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); ok(); }
        };
        document.addEventListener('keydown', _keyHandler);

        return new Promise(function (resolve) { _resolver = resolve; });
    }
    function _close(result) {
        document.getElementById('confirmModal').classList.remove('open');
        if (_keyHandler) { document.removeEventListener('keydown', _keyHandler); _keyHandler = null; }
        if (_resolver) { var r = _resolver; _resolver = null; r(result); }
    }
    function ok()     { _close(true);  }
    function cancel() { _close(false); }
    function closeIfOverlay(e) { if (e && e.target && e.target.id === 'confirmModal') cancel(); }
    return { show: show, ok: ok, cancel: cancel, closeIfOverlay: closeIfOverlay };
})();

// ============================================================================
// MAPPING MODAL
// ============================================================================
var MappingModal = (function () {

    function _mappingKey() {
        var srcId = state.sourceProfile ? state.sourceProfile.id : 'unknown';
        return srcId + '|' + state.targetKind;
    }

    function _loadSavedMapping() {
        var all = _resolve('mappings', {}) || {};
        return all[_mappingKey()] || null;
    }

    function _saveMapping(map) {
        if (!_settingsReady()) return;
        try {
            var all = _resolve('mappings', {}) || {};
            all[_mappingKey()] = {
                mappings: map,
                sourceHeaders: state.sourceHeaders.slice(),
                savedAt: new Date().toISOString()
            };
            FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('mappings', all);
            FBLib.Settings.saveUser();
        } catch (e) { debugLog('Mapping save failed: ' + e.message, 'warn'); }
    }

    function _bestMappingForField(fbField) {
        // Vocab-controlled fields use strict matching — see autoMatchScore
        // comment. This stops `Tax Exempt` getting auto-mapped to `TaxRate`
        // (causing "yes"/"no" to land in a column the vocab can't validate).
        var schema = FB_SCHEMAS[state.targetKind];
        var colDef = schema && schema.columns.find(function (c) { return c.key === fbField; });
        var strict = !!(colDef && colDef.vocab);
        var bestScore = 0, bestCol = null;
        state.sourceHeaders.forEach(function (col) {
            var s = autoMatchScore(fbField, col, { strict: strict });
            if (s > bestScore) { bestScore = s; bestCol = col; }
        });
        return bestCol;
    }

    function _render() {
        var schema = FB_SCHEMAS[state.targetKind];
        document.getElementById('mappingModalTitle').textContent =
            'Map ' + (state.sourceProfile ? state.sourceProfile.label : 'source') +
            ' → ' + schema.label;

        var host = document.getElementById('mappingRows');
        host.innerHTML = '';
        _visibleColumns(schema, true).forEach(function (col) {
            var required = (typeof col.required === 'function') ? false : !!col.required;
            var row = document.createElement('div');
            row.className = 'mapping-row';

            var labelDiv = document.createElement('div');
            labelDiv.className = 'mapping-label';
            var nameDiv = document.createElement('div');
            if (required) nameDiv.classList.add('required-field');
            nameDiv.innerHTML = escapeHtml(col.key) + (col.maxLength ? ' <span class="mapping-note">(' + col.type + ', ' + col.maxLength + ' chars)</span>' : ' <span class="mapping-note">(' + (col.type || 'Text') + ')</span>');
            labelDiv.appendChild(nameDiv);
            if (col.desc) {
                var d = document.createElement('div');
                d.className = 'mapping-note'; d.textContent = col.desc;
                labelDiv.appendChild(d);
            }

            var arrow = document.createElement('div');
            arrow.className = 'mapping-arrow'; arrow.textContent = '←';

            // Primary selector always shown. Secondary "+ Concatenate"
            // selector is gated by `col.concatenable` — only enabled on
            // human-name / address-line columns (Customer + Vendor: Name,
            // AddressName, AddressContact, Address). Other fields are
            // single-value by nature and don't get the extra slot. See
            // the schema definitions for the explicit list.
            var selWrap = document.createElement('div');
            selWrap.style.cssText = 'display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px;';

            var currentCols = _mappingCols(state.fieldMappings[col.key]);

            function _buildMapSel(slotIdx, placeholderText) {
                var s = document.createElement('select');
                s.className = 'mapping-select';
                s.dataset.field = col.key;
                s.dataset.slot = String(slotIdx);
                if (slotIdx === 0) s.dataset.required = String(required);
                var blank = document.createElement('option');
                blank.value = ''; blank.textContent = placeholderText;
                s.appendChild(blank);
                state.sourceHeaders.forEach(function (h) {
                    var o = document.createElement('option');
                    o.value = h; o.textContent = h;
                    if (currentCols[slotIdx] === h) o.selected = true;
                    s.appendChild(o);
                });
                return s;
            }

            var sel  = _buildMapSel(0, '(None)');
            var sel2 = null;
            if (col.concatenable) {
                sel2 = _buildMapSel(1, '+ Concatenate another column (optional)');
                // Visually a touch lighter so the optional-ness reads.
                sel2.style.fontSize = '11px';
                sel2.style.opacity = '0.9';
            }

            // Single change-handler. Writes back a string (1 col) or array
            // (2 cols) so the storage shape is tight when it can be. For
            // non-concatenable columns sel2 is null and the handler reads
            // only the primary value.
            function _applyMapChange() {
                var v1 = sel.value;
                var v2 = sel2 ? sel2.value : '';
                var picked = [];
                if (v1) picked.push(v1);
                // Ignore a secondary pick that duplicates the primary —
                // "First Name + First Name" would just produce a doubled
                // value, almost certainly a mistake.
                if (v2 && v2 !== v1) picked.push(v2);
                if (!picked.length)              state.fieldMappings[col.key] = '';
                else if (picked.length === 1)    state.fieldMappings[col.key] = picked[0];
                else                              state.fieldMappings[col.key] = picked;
                sel.classList.toggle('is-invalid', required && !v1);
            }
            sel.addEventListener('change', _applyMapChange);
            if (sel2) sel2.addEventListener('change', _applyMapChange);
            if (required && !sel.value) sel.classList.add('is-invalid');

            selWrap.appendChild(sel);
            if (sel2) selWrap.appendChild(sel2);

            row.appendChild(labelDiv);
            row.appendChild(arrow);
            row.appendChild(selWrap);
            host.appendChild(row);
        });
    }

    function open() {
        if (!state.sourceHeaders.length) return;
        _render();
        document.getElementById('mappingModal').classList.add('open');
    }
    function close() { document.getElementById('mappingModal').classList.remove('open'); }
    function closeIfOverlay(e) { if (e && e.target && e.target.id === 'mappingModal') close(); }

    function saveAndProcess() {
        // Required-field enforcement deliberately doesn't block saving here —
        // a source CSV may legitimately lack a column that Fishbowl considers
        // required (e.g. no Status column from Shopify Customers when
        // Customer.Active is required). Required-field gaps surface as
        // per-cell issues in the output table, where the user can fix them
        // via direct edit, the column-overwrite "Fill empty" control, or
        // "Copy from column" — much more powerful than rejecting the file.
        var schema = FB_SCHEMAS[state.targetKind];
        var missing = [];
        _visibleColumns(schema, true).forEach(function (col) {
            var required = (typeof col.required === 'function') ? false : !!col.required;
            // Use _mappingCols so the array (concat) shape counts as mapped.
            if (required && !_mappingCols(state.fieldMappings[col.key]).length) missing.push(col.key);
        });
        if (missing.length) {
            // Information-only notice; user is free to proceed.
            debugLog('Proceeding with unmapped required fields: ' + missing.join(', ')
                + '. They will surface as per-row issues in the output table.', 'warn');
        }
        _saveMapping(state.fieldMappings);
        close();
        processRows();
    }

    // External: seed (called after source load + when changing targets).
    function seed() {
        var saved = _loadSavedMapping();
        var schema = FB_SCHEMAS[state.targetKind];
        state.fieldMappings = {};

        if (saved && saved.mappings) {
            // Saved mappings only honoured when every source column still exists.
            // _mappingCols normalises string AND array shapes -> we check
            // every referenced column survives in the new source headers.
            var stillValid = Object.keys(saved.mappings).every(function (k) {
                var cols = _mappingCols(saved.mappings[k]);
                return cols.every(function (c) { return state.sourceHeaders.indexOf(c) !== -1; });
            });
            if (stillValid) {
                state.fieldMappings = Object.assign({}, saved.mappings);
                debugLog('Restored saved mapping (' + Object.keys(state.fieldMappings).length + ' fields) for ' + _mappingKey(), 'info');
                return;
            }
            debugLog('Saved mapping for ' + _mappingKey() + ' is stale (source columns changed) — re-seeding from auto-match', 'warn');
        }

        // Profile-provided seed first…
        if (state.sourceProfile && state.sourceProfile.suggestMapping) {
            state.fieldMappings = state.sourceProfile.suggestMapping(state.sourceHeaders, _visibleColumns(schema, true));
        }
        // …then auto-match fill-in for unmapped fields.
        _visibleColumns(schema, true).forEach(function (col) {
            if (state.fieldMappings[col.key]) return;
            var best = _bestMappingForField(col.key);
            if (best) state.fieldMappings[col.key] = best;
        });
    }

    return { open: open, close: close, closeIfOverlay: closeIfOverlay, saveAndProcess: saveAndProcess, seed: seed };
})();

function seedFieldMappings() { MappingModal.seed(); }

function changeTarget(newKind) {
    if (!FB_SCHEMAS[newKind]) return;
    state.targetKind = newKind;
    // Reset display-only state — the columns are about to change, so any
    // sort/filter on the old target's column keys is meaningless on the new
    // target. The exported CSV is unaffected (sort/filter are display-only).
    state.sortCol = null;
    state.sortDir = 'asc';
    state.columnFilters = {};
    state.selectedRows.clear();
    state.kpiFilter = null;
    state._lazyItems = null;
    state._lazyRenderedCount = 0;
    // Hidden-columns are stored per-target — load the new target's set.
    _restoreHiddenCols();
    updateColumnsButtonLabel();
    debugLog('Target changed to ' + newKind, 'info');
    _updateDrawerSummary();
    seedFieldMappings();
    MappingModal.open();
}

// ============================================================================
// UNDO / REDO  — action-record history.
//
// Action shapes:
//   { type: 'set',    rowIdx, colKey, oldValue, newValue }
//   { type: 'delete', rowIdx, row }                          (row = the full deleted row object)
//   { type: 'bulk',   label, changes: [{rowIdx, colKey, oldValue, newValue}, ...] }
//
// Indices are recorded at the time of the action and remain valid for strict
// linear undo/redo because:
//   - Each subsequent action sees the state produced by the previous one.
//   - When we undo a 'delete', we re-insert at the recorded idx; this is the
//     reverse of the original splice, so older actions whose indices were
//     recorded BEFORE the delete remain pointing at the same rows.
//   - We truncate any redo branch on a new push, so divergent timelines
//     can't desync.
//
// `pushing` re-entrancy flag stops undo/redo from recording the synthetic
// mutations they perform.
// ============================================================================
var History = (function () {
    var stack = [];
    var cursor = -1;             // points at the index of the most recent applied action
    var LIMIT = 100;             // cap so memory stays bounded on 1000-row imports
    var pushing = false;         // true while undo/redo are applying — skip recording

    function reset() {
        stack = [];
        cursor = -1;
        _updateButtons();
    }
    function push(action) {
        if (pushing) return;
        // Truncate any "future" beyond the cursor so we don't keep stale
        // redo entries after a new action diverges from them.
        stack.length = cursor + 1;
        stack.push(action);
        cursor = stack.length - 1;
        if (stack.length > LIMIT) {
            stack.shift();
            cursor--;
        }
        _updateButtons();
    }
    function canUndo() { return cursor >= 0; }
    function canRedo() { return cursor < stack.length - 1; }

    function undo() {
        if (!canUndo()) return;
        var action = stack[cursor];
        cursor--;
        pushing = true;
        try { _apply(action, /*reverse*/true); }
        finally { pushing = false; }
        _afterMutation('Undid: ' + _label(action));
    }
    function redo() {
        if (!canRedo()) return;
        cursor++;
        var action = stack[cursor];
        pushing = true;
        try { _apply(action, /*reverse*/false); }
        finally { pushing = false; }
        _afterMutation('Redid: ' + _label(action));
    }

    function _apply(action, reverse) {
        if (action.type === 'set') {
            var row = state.targetRows[action.rowIdx];
            if (row) row[action.colKey] = reverse ? action.oldValue : action.newValue;
        } else if (action.type === 'delete') {
            if (reverse) state.targetRows.splice(action.rowIdx, 0, action.row);
            else         state.targetRows.splice(action.rowIdx, 1);
        } else if (action.type === 'bulkdelete') {
            // Many-row delete recorded as ONE undo step. Forward (delete)
            // runs in descending idx order so earlier indices stay valid
            // through the loop; reverse (restore) runs in ascending idx
            // order so each splice-insert puts the row back in its
            // original slot.
            if (reverse) {
                action.items.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a.idx - b.idx; })
                    .forEach(function (it) { state.targetRows.splice(it.idx, 0, it.row); });
            } else {
                action.items.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return b.idx - a.idx; })
                    .forEach(function (it) { state.targetRows.splice(it.idx, 1); });
            }
        } else if (action.type === 'bulk') {
            action.changes.forEach(function (c) {
                var r = state.targetRows[c.rowIdx];
                if (r) r[c.colKey] = reverse ? c.oldValue : c.newValue;
            });
        }
    }
    function _label(action) {
        if (action.type === 'set')        return 'edit ' + action.colKey;
        if (action.type === 'delete')     return 'delete row';
        if (action.type === 'bulkdelete') return 'delete ' + action.items.length + ' rows';
        if (action.type === 'bulk')       return action.label || 'bulk change';
        return action.type;
    }
    function _afterMutation(msg) {
        // validateAllRows() recomputes the cross-row duplicate map AND
        // calls updateSummaryStats(), so a single call replaces the prior
        // forEach + updateSummaryStats pair.
        validateAllRows();
        renderResultsTable();
        _updateButtons();

// Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+Z (undo), Ctrl+Y / Ctrl+Shift+Z (redo).
//   - In an input/select OUTSIDE our results table (settings, search, etc.):
//     defer to the native browser behaviour so reps can undo their typing
//     in those fields normally.
//   - In OUR table cells (or anywhere else on the page): take over and run
//     table-level undo/redo. This is the user's expected mental model —
//     once a cell edit commits (Enter / Tab / blur), the action is pushed
//     to history and Ctrl+Z reverses it.
document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (!(e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) return;
    var key = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (key !== 'z' && key !== 'y') return;
    var tag = e.target && e.target.tagName;
    var inEditable = (tag === 'INPUT' || tag === 'SELECT' || tag === 'TEXTAREA');
    var inOurTable = inEditable && !!e.target.closest('table.import-table');
    if (inEditable && !inOurTable) return;   // defer to native undo elsewhere
    if (key === 'z' && !e.shiftKey)                        { History.undo(); e.preventDefault(); }

function _settingDefaults() {
    return {
        defaultUOM:                _resolve('defaultUOM', 'ea'),
        defaultTaxCode:            _resolve('defaultTaxCode', 'NON'),
        defaultWeightUOM:          _resolve('defaultWeightUOM', 'kg'),
        defaultCustomerStatus:     _resolve('defaultCustomerStatus', 'Normal'),
        defaultCustomerPriority:   _resolve('defaultCustomerPriority', '3-Normal'),
        defaultVendorStatus:       _resolve('defaultVendorStatus', 'Normal'),
        defaultAccountPrefix:      _resolve('defaultAccountPrefix', 'SHOP-')

// Progress overlay used by processRows() while it chunks through a large
// source CSV. Non-dismissible — the user is meant to wait. Three steps
// reported: building rows → validating → rendering, with a per-stage
// progress bar updated between batches.
var ProcessingOverlay = (function () {
    var el = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
    return {
        show: function (title) {
            if (el('processingTitle')) el('processingTitle').textContent = title || 'Processing rows…';
            if (el('processingMsg')) el('processingMsg').textContent = 'Preparing…';
            if (el('processingBar')) el('processingBar').style.width = '0%';
            if (el('processingModal')) el('processingModal').classList.add('open');
        },
        update: function (current, total, label) {
            var pct = total ? Math.round((current / total) * 100) : 0;
            var msg = (label ? label + ' · ' : '') +
                current.toLocaleString() + ' / ' + total.toLocaleString() + ' rows  (' + pct + '%)';
            if (el('processingMsg')) el('processingMsg').textContent = msg;
            if (el('processingBar')) el('processingBar').style.width = pct + '%';
        },
        setStage: function (label) {
            if (el('processingMsg')) el('processingMsg').textContent = label;
        },
        hide: function () {
            if (el('processingModal')) el('processingModal').classList.remove('open');
        }

})();

// Chunked source→target transform. Big Shopify product exports can run
// 5000+ rows; doing the work in one synchronous pass freezes the page and
// the user can't tell if anything's happening. Instead we process in
// `BATCH`-row chunks, yield to the browser between batches so the spinner
// updates, then chain validate + render the same way.
//
// `BATCH` is the sweet spot — small enough that each tick is well under
// 100ms on a modest laptop, large enough that scheduler overhead is
// negligible.
function processRows() {
    if (!state.sourceRows.length) {
        showMessage('No source rows to process', 'warn');
        return;
    }
    var schema = FB_SCHEMAS[state.targetKind];
    var ctx = { defaults: _settingDefaults() };
    var out = [];
    var skipped = 0;
    var i = 0;
    var total = state.sourceRows.length;
    var BATCH = 200;

    ProcessingOverlay.show('Building Fishbowl rows…');
    // Yield once so the overlay can actually paint before the synchronous
    // work begins. Without this, the browser may not have flushed the
    // overlay to the screen by the time the first batch is queued.
    setTimeout(processBatch, 50);

    function processBatch() {
        var end = Math.min(i + BATCH, total);
        for (; i < end; i++) {
            var src = state.sourceRows[i];
            var row;
            if (state.sourceProfile && state.sourceProfile.transformRow) {
                row = state.sourceProfile.transformRow(src, ctx, state.fieldMappings);
            } else {
                // Generic copy-via-mapping when no profile-specific transformer.
                // _mappedValue handles single + concat mapping shapes.
                row = {};
                Object.keys(state.fieldMappings).forEach(function (fbField) {
                    var v = _mappedValue(src, state.fieldMappings[fbField]);
                    if (v != null && v !== '') row[fbField] = v;
                });
            }
            if (row && row._skip) {
                skipped++;
                if (DEBUG_MODE) debugLog('Skipped row ' + src._sourceRowNum + ': ' + row.reason, 'info');
                continue;
            }
            row._sourceRowNum = src._sourceRowNum;
            // Normalise Decimal / Numeric cells up-front so values pulled
            // in from Shopify ("$12.99", "1,234.50") become clean numeric
            // strings ready for Fishbowl. Non-parseable values are left
            // as-is so they surface as validation errors in the table.
            _visibleColumns(schema, true).forEach(function (col) {
                if (col.type !== 'Decimal' && col.type !== 'Numeric') return;
                var v = row[col.key];
                if (v == null || String(v).trim() === '') return;
                var n = normalizeDecimal(v);
                if (n !== null) row[col.key] = n;
            });
            out.push(row);
        }
        ProcessingOverlay.update(i, total, 'Transforming');
        if (i < total) {
            setTimeout(processBatch, 0);
        } else {
            finishTransform();
        }
    }

    function finishTransform() {
        state.targetRows = out;
        state.skippedCount = skipped;
        debugLog('Transformed ' + out.length + ' rows (' + skipped + ' skipped) → ' + schema.label, 'success');
        // New transform = clean history slate. Existing undo/redo entries
        // are about old rows that no longer exist. Same goes for selection
        // — old row object references are now stale.
        History.reset();
        state.selectedRows.clear();
        ProcessingOverlay.setStage('Validating ' + out.length.toLocaleString() + ' rows…');
        // Validate + render in the next tick so the "Validating…" label
        // paints before validation blocks the main thread.
        setTimeout(function () {
            validateAllRows();
            ProcessingOverlay.setStage('Rendering table…');
            setTimeout(function () {
                renderResultsTable();
                document.getElementById('summaryStats').classList.remove('hidden');
                document.getElementById('resultsCard').classList.remove('hidden');
                ProcessingOverlay.hide();
            }, 15);
        }, 15);
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// VALIDATION — runs after every change. Marks rows {_status, _cellIssues}.
// ============================================================================
function validateAllRows() {
    var schema = FB_SCHEMAS[state.targetKind];
    // Precompute cross-row duplicate sets for any column tagged `unique: true`
    // (PPVP.PartNumber today). The per-row validateRow() then does a single
    // O(1) Set.has() lookup, so adding the check is cheap even on 5k+ row
    // imports. Kept on `state` so the renderer + summary-stats can re-use
    // the same map without recomputing per row.
    state._duplicateValues = _computeUniqueValueDuplicates(schema);
    state.targetRows.forEach(function (row) { validateRow(row, schema); });
    updateSummaryStats();
}

// Scan all rows for columns tagged `unique: true`; return a map
// { colKey: Set<value> } containing only values that appear MORE THAN ONCE.
// Empty / whitespace-only values are ignored (can't be a "duplicate" of
// nothing; the required-field check handles those separately).
function _computeUniqueValueDuplicates(schema) {
    var out = {};
    if (!schema || !schema.columns) return out;
    schema.columns.forEach(function (col) {
        if (!col.unique) return;
        var counts = Object.create(null);
        state.targetRows.forEach(function (r) {
            var v = r[col.key];
            if (v == null) return;
            var s = String(v).trim();
            if (s === '') return;
            counts[s] = (counts[s] || 0) + 1;
        });
        var dupes = new Set();
        Object.keys(counts).forEach(function (k) { if (counts[k] > 1) dupes.add(k); });
        out[col.key] = dupes;
    });
    return out;
}

// Helper for the renderer + stats: does this row contain ANY duplicate value
// in a unique-tagged column? Cheap because `_duplicateValues` is precomputed.
function _rowHasDuplicate(row, schema) {
    if (!state._duplicateValues) return false;
    var keys = Object.keys(state._duplicateValues);
    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
        var k = keys[i];
        var v = row[k];
        if (v == null) continue;
        var s = String(v).trim();
        if (s === '') continue;
        if (state._duplicateValues[k].has(s)) return true;
    }
    return false;
}
function validateRow(row, schema) {
    var issues = {};      // hard issues — required-empty / type / length on any field, vocab on REQUIRED fields
    var warnings = {};    // soft warnings — vocab "Unknown value" on optional fields. Visible but don't escalate row status.
    // Per-cell issue KIND — drives KPI counters + the click-to-filter
    // mechanism. One of:
    //   'required' | 'type' | 'length' | 'duplicate'
    //   'missing-vendor' | 'missing-uom' | 'missing-uom-conversion'
    //   'unknown-value' (other vocab mismatches)
    // The kind is recorded for BOTH issues and warnings — a UOM with no
    // conversion is only a warning, but we still want the KPI badge to
    // surface it. updateSummaryStats reads _cellIssueKinds across both
    // maps.
    var kinds = {};
    _visibleColumns(schema, true).forEach(function (col) {
        var v = row[col.key];
        var hasVal = !(v == null || String(v).trim() === '');

        // Required check.
        var required = (typeof col.required === 'function') ? !!col.required(row) : !!col.required;
        if (required && !hasVal) { issues[col.key] = 'Required'; kinds[col.key] = 'required'; return; }
        if (!hasVal) return;

        // Type check.
        var typeErr = validateType(String(v), col.type, col.key);
        if (typeErr) { issues[col.key] = typeErr; kinds[col.key] = 'type'; return; }

        // Length check.
        if (col.maxLength && String(v).length > col.maxLength) {
            issues[col.key] = 'Exceeds ' + col.maxLength + ' chars';
            kinds[col.key] = 'length';
            return;
        }

        // Vocab check — informational on non-required fields by default.
        // Columns can override with `vocabSeverity: 'issue'` to force a
        // hard issue even when the column itself isn't required (used by
        // PPVP.Vendor: missing vendor isn't a Fishbowl-blocking error,
        // but we want it to surface in the row-status pill so the user
        // sees it on the way to creating the vendor before import).
        // `vocabMessage` overrides the default text.
        if (col.vocab) {
            var opts = vocabOptions(col.vocab);
            if (opts && opts.length) {
                var match = opts.some(function (o) {
                    return String(o.value).toLowerCase() === String(v).toLowerCase()
                        || String(o.label).toLowerCase() === String(v).toLowerCase();
                });
                if (!match) {
                    var severity = col.vocabSeverity || (required ? 'issue' : 'warning');
                    var dfltMsg = (severity === 'issue') ? 'Unknown value' : 'Unknown value (not in Fishbowl reference list)';
                    var msg = col.vocabMessage || dfltMsg;
                    // Kind is derived from the vocab type so the KPI
                    // counters can group cells without inspecting the
                    // message text.
                    var kind = (col.vocab === 'existingVendors') ? 'missing-vendor'
                             : (col.vocab === 'uoms') ? 'missing-uom'
                             : 'unknown-value';
                    if (severity === 'issue') issues[col.key] = msg;
                    else                       warnings[col.key] = msg;
                    kinds[col.key] = kind;
                } else if (col.vocab === 'uoms'
                           && refData.uomConversionCodes
                           && refData.uomConversionCodes.size > 0
                           && !refData.uomConversionCodes.has(String(v).trim())) {
                    // UOM value is a real UOM but has no entries in
                    // `uomconversion`. Fishbowl will fail to convert
                    // between this UOM and any other UOM at import time,
                    // so any row that pairs it with a different UOM of
                    // the same type breaks. Soft warning so the user
                    // can decide whether to add a conversion or change
                    // the value before importing.
                    warnings[col.key] = 'No conversion defined in Fishbowl for "' + v + '" — add one before importing, or the row may fail to import.';
                    kinds[col.key] = 'missing-uom-conversion';
                }
            }
        }

        // Uniqueness check — column tagged `unique: true` means the value
        // must be unique across all rows in the target. `validateAllRows()`
        // precomputes `state._duplicateValues[col.key]` as a Set of any
        // values that appear more than once, so this is an O(1) lookup.
        if (col.unique && hasVal
            && state._duplicateValues
            && state._duplicateValues[col.key]
            && state._duplicateValues[col.key].has(String(v).trim())) {
            issues[col.key] = 'Duplicate ' + col.key + ' (appears more than once in this import)';
            kinds[col.key] = 'duplicate';
        }
    });
    row._cellIssues = issues;
    row._cellWarnings = warnings;
    row._cellIssueKinds = kinds;
    // Row status only escalates to "issues" when there's at least one
    // hard issue. Vocab mismatches on optional fields stay visible at
    // cell level but don't make the row red.
    row._status = Object.keys(issues).length ? 'issues' : 'ready';
}
function validateType(value, type, field) {
    switch (type) {
        case 'Integer':
            if (!/^-?\d+$/.test(value)) return 'Not a valid integer';
            break;
        case 'Decimal':
        case 'Numeric':
            // Reuse the canonical normaliser so what we validate is exactly
            // what would be written to CSV. Returns null when input can't
            // be coerced into a number.
            if (normalizeDecimal(value) === null) return 'Not a valid number (use e.g. 1234.50)';
            break;
        case 'Boolean':
            var bool = ['true', 'false', '1', '0', 'yes', 'no'];
            if (bool.indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) === -1) return 'Not a valid boolean';
            break;

    return null;

// Coerce a user-typed value like "$1,234.50", "AUD 12.99", " £1,234.50 ",
// "€100", or "1234" into a plain numeric string ("1234.50"). Returns null
// when nothing numeric can be found — caller treats that as a validation
// error and leaves the original value in place so the user can see what
// was rejected.
// ----
// We strip aggressively: ANY character that isn't a digit, decimal point,
// or leading minus is dropped before parse. This handles every currency
// symbol ($ £ € ¥ ₹ ₩ etc), every currency code (USD / AUD / GBP / EUR /
// AED / JPY …), thousand separators, leading/trailing whitespace, and
// stray suffixes ("AUD 12.99" / "12.99 USD"). Applied to every Decimal/
// Numeric column in processRows() and on every Decimal/Numeric cell edit
// in _buildBodyRow's change handler.
function normalizeDecimal(value) {
    if (value == null) return null;
    var s = String(value).trim();
    if (s === '') return null;
    // Track sign separately so a stray dash inside the value (e.g.
    // "AUD-12.99" or "12.99-") still resolves to -12.99 cleanly.
    var negative = s.indexOf('-') !== -1;
    // Drop anything that isn't a digit or decimal point.
    var clean = s.replace(/[^\d.]/g, '');
    // Multi-dot values ("1.234.56") are ambiguous (European thousands
    // separator vs typo). Keep only the LAST dot as the decimal mark and
    // strip the rest; this matches what Excel does on paste.
    var lastDot = clean.lastIndexOf('.');
    if (lastDot !== -1 && clean.indexOf('.') !== lastDot) {
        clean = clean.slice(0, lastDot).replace(/\./g, '') + clean.slice(lastDot);
    }
    if (clean === '' || clean === '.') return null;
    var n = parseFloat(clean);
    if (isNaN(n)) return null;
    if (negative) n = -Math.abs(n);
    return String(n);
}
function updateSummaryStats() {
    var schema = FB_SCHEMAS[state.targetKind];
    var total = state.targetRows.length;
    var ready = 0, issues = 0, missing = 0, dupes = 0;
    // KPI counters — counts of ROWS (not cells) that have at least one
    // cell with the given issue kind. A row with two missing-UOM cells
    // counts as 1 in `kpiMissingUom`.
    var kpiMissingVendor = 0, kpiMissingUom = 0, kpiMissingUomConv = 0;
    state.targetRows.forEach(function (r) {
        if (r._status === 'ready') ready++;
        else issues++;
        // Count rows with any required-cell gap separately so the user sees the
        // most actionable subset.
        var anyMissingRequired = _visibleColumns(schema, true).some(function (col) {
            var required = (typeof col.required === 'function') ? !!col.required(r) : !!col.required;
            return required && (!r[col.key] || String(r[col.key]).trim() === '');
        });
        if (anyMissingRequired) missing++;
        if (_rowHasDuplicate(r, schema)) dupes++;
        if (_rowHasIssueKind(r, 'missing-vendor'))          kpiMissingVendor++;
        if (_rowHasIssueKind(r, 'missing-uom'))             kpiMissingUom++;
        if (_rowHasIssueKind(r, 'missing-uom-conversion'))  kpiMissingUomConv++;
    });
    document.getElementById('statTotal').textContent = total;
    document.getElementById('statReady').textContent = ready;
    document.getElementById('statIssues').textContent = issues;
    document.getElementById('statMissing').textContent = missing;
    document.getElementById('statSkipped').textContent = state.skippedCount;
    var dupesEl = document.getElementById('statDupes');
    if (dupesEl) dupesEl.textContent = dupes;
    _updateDupesFilterVisibility();
    _updateKpiBadge('kpiMissingVendors',         'kpiMissingVendorsCount',         kpiMissingVendor,    'missing-vendor');
    _updateKpiBadge('kpiMissingUoms',            'kpiMissingUomsCount',            kpiMissingUom,       'missing-uom');
    _updateKpiBadge('kpiMissingUomConversions',  'kpiMissingUomConversionsCount',  kpiMissingUomConv,   'missing-uom-conversion');
    document.getElementById('resultsSubtitle').textContent =
        '· ' + total + ' rows · ' + ready + ' ready · ' + issues + ' with issues' +
        (dupes ? ' · ' + dupes + ' duplicate' : '');

// Toggle (set / clear) the KPI filter for `kind`. Clicking the active KPI

    // rebuilding the header (which would otherwise blow away the filter
    // input's own focus on every keystroke). _renderBody also wires the
    // delegated drag-drop and renders the empty-state placeholder.
    _renderBody(schema);

    // Snap the bulk-control row's sticky `top` to the title row's actual
    // rendered height. The CSS ships a static `top: 50px` placeholder, but
    // the title row's true height varies (longer column names wrap; the
    // browser's default <th> line metrics vary 2–3px). Without this, the
    // bulk row either leaves a transparent gap above it (body content
    // visibly scrolls through that strip) or overlaps the first body
    // row(s), making them unreachable at scrollTop=0. rAF defers until
    // after layout so getBoundingClientRect reads the post-paint height.
    requestAnimationFrame(function () { _alignStickyHeaders(); _applyFrozenColumns(); });
}

// Sort-indicator SVG. Three states:
//   - 'asc'   → single arrow pointing up (column sorted ascending)
//   - 'desc'  → single arrow pointing down (column sorted descending)
//   - default → vertical two-headed arrow (idle / unsorted). This is
//               the .col-remap-btn arrow-swap icon rotated 90° so the
//               two header-row affordances match in size + style.
// All three share the 24×24 viewBox + 2.2 stroke of the remap icon so
// the actual painted glyph weight matches. The `display:block` on the
// SVG comes from the .col-sort-indicator CSS rule above.
function _sortIconSvg(state) {
    var common = 'viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" ' +
                 'stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"';
    if (state === 'asc') {
        return '<svg ' + common + '>' +
               '<polyline points="6 10 12 4 18 10"/>' +
               '<line x1="12" y1="4" x2="12" y2="20"/>' +
               '</svg>';
    }
    if (state === 'desc') {
        return '<svg ' + common + '>' +
               '<polyline points="6 14 12 20 18 14"/>' +
               '<line x1="12" y1="4" x2="12" y2="20"/>' +
               '</svg>';
    }
    // Idle — remap arrow-swap rotated 90° (vertical two-headed).
    return '<svg ' + common + '>' +
           '<polyline points="3 7 7 3 11 7"/>' +
           '<line x1="7" y1="3" x2="7" y2="21"/>' +
           '<polyline points="13 17 17 21 21 17"/>' +
           '<line x1="17" y1="3" x2="17" y2="21"/>' +
           '</svg>';
}

// Measure the title row's actual height and apply it as the bulk row's
// sticky `top`. Called from renderResultsTable() after each render and from
// a window-resize listener (column widths reflow → title row may rewrap).
function _alignStickyHeaders() {
    var headerRow = document.getElementById('resultsHeaderRow');
    var bulkRow = document.getElementById('resultsBulkRow');
    if (!headerRow || !bulkRow) return;
    var th = headerRow.querySelector('th');
    if (!th) return;
    var h = Math.ceil(th.getBoundingClientRect().height);
    if (!h) return;
    var bulkThs = bulkRow.querySelectorAll('th');
    for (var i = 0; i < bulkThs.length; i++) bulkThs[i].style.top = h + 'px';
}
window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    requestAnimationFrame(function () { _alignStickyHeaders(); _applyFrozenColumns(); });
});

// ============================================================================
// FREEZE-FIRST-COLUMN  (Excel-style)
// ----
// Pins the four metadata columns (select / delete / status / src#) + the
// first visible schema column to the left edge of the scroll container.
// Implementation: walk every row, find the leftmost N cells, set
// `position: sticky` with a cumulative `left` offset on each via inline
// style + tag each with `.col-locked` so the CSS handles background,
// z-index, and the drop-shadow edge marker.
// ----
// Called after every render that touches the table DOM (renderResultsTable,
// _renderBody, _appendNextLazyChunk) AND on window resize (the offsets
// depend on rendered cell widths).
// ============================================================================
function toggleFirstColLock() {
    state.frozenFirstCol = !state.frozenFirstCol;
    if (_settingsReady()) {
        try { FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('frozenFirstCol', state.frozenFirstCol); FBLib.Settings.saveUser(); } catch (_) {}
    }
    debugLog('Freeze first column: ' + state.frozenFirstCol, 'info');
    // Full re-render so the lock-button icon swaps + the sticky styles
    // apply to the new column set.
    renderResultsTable();
}

function _applyFrozenColumns() {
    var table = document.getElementById('resultsTable');
    if (!table) return;
    if (!state.frozenFirstCol) {
        table.classList.remove('frozen-left');
        return;
    }
    // Measure-ONCE: read the first row's first 5 cell widths to compute
    // cumulative left offsets, then set CSS variables on the table. The
    // CSS rules (above in <style>) apply `position: sticky; left: var(...)`
    // to every matching cell across every row via :nth-child, so we
    // don't need to touch each row — including rows added later by the
    // lazy chunk appender. Previously we walked every row × 5 cells and
    // called getBoundingClientRect per cell, which forced a synchronous
    // layout on each call (~1000 layouts per render). This version is
    // 200× faster.
    var firstRow = table.querySelector('tr');
    if (firstRow) {
        var cells = firstRow.children;
        var left = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < 5 && i < cells.length; i++) {
            if (i > 0) table.style.setProperty('--lock-l' + i, left + 'px');
            left += cells[i].getBoundingClientRect().width;
        }
    }
    table.classList.add('frozen-left');
}

// ============================================================================
// COLUMNS PICKER  (toolbar — hide / show individual schema columns)
// ----
// Reads `_visibleColumns(schema, true)` so the picker lists every
// region-applicable column regardless of current hide state. Toggling
// adds / removes from state.hiddenCols and updates the trigger-button
// label immediately, but the EXPENSIVE work (persist to Settings +
// renderResultsTable) is deferred until the popover closes. With a 5000-
// row PPVP import a single re-render is ~1s; without this deferral, every
// checkbox toggle re-rendered the whole table mid-click and the dropdown
// felt frozen between picks. `_columnsDirty` tracks whether any change
// happened while the popover was open; `_closeColumnsPopover()` is the
// single close path that flushes the work.
// ============================================================================
var _columnsDirty = false;

function toggleColumnsPopover(e) {
    if (e) e.stopPropagation();
    var dd = document.getElementById('columnsDropdown');
    if (!dd) return;
    var wasOpen = dd.classList.contains('open');
    // Close any sibling popover (filters dropdown uses the same pattern).
    var fdd = document.getElementById('filtersDropdown');
    if (fdd) fdd.classList.remove('open');
    if (wasOpen) {
        _closeColumnsPopover();
    } else {
        _columnsDirty = false;
        _renderColumnsPopover();
        dd.classList.add('open');
        setTimeout(function () { document.addEventListener('click', _columnsOutsideClick); }, 0);
    }
}

function _columnsOutsideClick(e) {
    var dd = document.getElementById('columnsDropdown');
    if (!dd) { document.removeEventListener('click', _columnsOutsideClick); return; }
    if (!dd.contains(e.target)) _closeColumnsPopover();
}

// Single close path — drops the open class, detaches the outside-click
// listener, and (if any column visibility changed while the popover was
// open) flushes the persist + table re-render exactly once.
function _closeColumnsPopover() {
    var dd = document.getElementById('columnsDropdown');
    if (dd) dd.classList.remove('open');
    document.removeEventListener('click', _columnsOutsideClick);
    if (_columnsDirty) {
        _columnsDirty = false;
        _persistHiddenCols();
        renderResultsTable();
    }
}

function _renderColumnsPopover() {
    var pop = document.getElementById('columnsPopover');
    if (!pop) return;
    var schema = FB_SCHEMAS[state.targetKind];
    var allCols = _visibleColumns(schema, true);
    var firstKey = _firstSchemaColKey();
    var html = '<div class="col-actions">' +
        '<a id="colsShowAll">Show all</a>' +
        '<a id="colsHideAll">Hide all</a>' +
        '</div>';
    allCols.forEach(function (col) {
        var checked = !state.hiddenCols.has(col.key);
        // The first schema column hosts the lock button, so it can't be
        // hidden — disable its checkbox so the user can't accidentally
        // make the lock target disappear.
        var disabled = (col.key === firstKey);
        html += '<label class="col-row">' +
            '<input type="checkbox" data-col-key="' + escapeHtml(col.key) + '"' +
                (checked ? ' checked' : '') +
                (disabled ? ' disabled title="The first column hosts the freeze-column lock and is always shown"' : '') +
                '>' +
            '<span>' + escapeHtml(col.key) + '</span>' +
            '</label>';
    });
    pop.innerHTML = html;
    pop.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]').forEach(function (cb) {
        cb.addEventListener('change', function () {
            var key = cb.dataset.colKey;
            if (cb.checked) state.hiddenCols.delete(key);
            else state.hiddenCols.add(key);
            // Mark dirty + refresh the trigger-button label so the user
            // sees the running "Columns (N hidden)" count update live.
            // The expensive persist + table re-render happens once, on
            // close — see _closeColumnsPopover().
            _columnsDirty = true;
            updateColumnsButtonLabel();
        });
    });
    var showAll = pop.querySelector('#colsShowAll');
    var hideAll = pop.querySelector('#colsHideAll');
    if (showAll) showAll.addEventListener('click', function () {
        state.hiddenCols.clear();
        _columnsDirty = true;
        _renderColumnsPopover();
        updateColumnsButtonLabel();
    });
    if (hideAll) hideAll.addEventListener('click', function () {
        allCols.forEach(function (c) { if (c.key !== firstKey) state.hiddenCols.add(c.key); });
        _columnsDirty = true;
        _renderColumnsPopover();
        updateColumnsButtonLabel();
    });
}

function _persistHiddenCols() {
    if (!_settingsReady()) return;
    try {
        var all = _resolve('hiddenCols', {}) || {};
        all[state.targetKind] = [].slice.call(state.hiddenCols);
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('hiddenCols', all);
        FBLib.Settings.saveUser();
    } catch (_) {}
}

function _restoreHiddenCols() {
    var all = _resolve('hiddenCols', {}) || {};
    var saved = all[state.targetKind];
    state.hiddenCols = new Set(Array.isArray(saved) ? saved : []);
}

function updateColumnsButtonLabel() {
    var lbl = document.getElementById('columnsBtnLabel');
    var btn = document.getElementById('columnsToggleBtn');
    if (!lbl || !btn) return;
    var n = state.hiddenCols.size;
    lbl.textContent = n ? ('Columns (' + n + ' hidden)') : 'Columns';
    btn.classList.toggle('filters-active', n > 0);
}

// "Src #" header — clickable to sort by original source-row order. Same
// 3-state toggle as the schema-column headers (asc -> desc -> off). The
// dataset key `_sourceRowNum` matches the property on each target row, so
// the existing _compareForSort numeric path handles it without any extra
// special-casing. Ascending = original CSV order, which is the natural
// "return to unsorted" gesture for a user lost in a sorted view.
function _buildSrcRowHeader() {
    var th = document.createElement('th');
    th.className = 'source-row-cell';
    th.dataset.colKey = '_sourceRowNum';
    var btn = document.createElement('div');
    btn.className = 'col-header-btn';
    // Right-align label + indicator together so the header reads like the
    // right-aligned numbers in the body cells below.
    btn.style.justifyContent = 'flex-end';
    btn.innerHTML = '<span class="col-name">Src #</span>';
    var ind = document.createElement('span');
    ind.className = 'col-sort-indicator';
    if (state.sortCol === '_sourceRowNum') {
        ind.classList.add('active');
        ind.innerHTML = _sortIconSvg(state.sortDir === 'desc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
    } else {
        ind.innerHTML = _sortIconSvg('idle');
    }
    btn.appendChild(ind);
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () { _toggleSort('_sourceRowNum'); });

    // Rich tooltip — same pattern as schema columns. No native `btn.title`
    // for the reasons noted in _buildHeaderCell (it would race the popover).
    var sortHintSrc = (state.sortCol === '_sourceRowNum')
        ? (state.sortDir === 'desc' ? 'Sorted ▼ — click to clear' : 'Sorted ▲ (original CSV order) — click for ▼')
        : 'Click to sort ▲ to restore original CSV order';
    var srcPayload = {
        title:    'Src #',
        required: false,
        desc:     'The source CSV row number this target row came from. Useful for tracing a transformed row back to the original file when you need to fix something upstream.',
        meta:     'Integer  •  ' + sortHintSrc
    };
    btn.addEventListener('mouseover', function (e) { showAppTooltip(e, srcPayload); });
    btn.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) { showAppTooltip(e, srcPayload); });
    btn.addEventListener('mouseout',  hideAppTooltip);

    th.appendChild(btn);
    return th;
}

// First-visible-schema-column key for the active target — this is the
// column that gets the lock button in its header and is treated as the
// rightmost frozen column when state.frozenFirstCol is on. PPVP → 'num'
// (PartNumber), Customer/Vendor → 'Name'. We compute this from the live
// _visibleColumns list rather than hardcoding so it survives schema
// edits and region toggles without manual updates.
function _firstSchemaColKey() {
    var schema = FB_SCHEMAS[state.targetKind];
    var cols = _visibleColumns(schema);
    return cols.length ? cols[0].key : null;
}

// ============================================================================
// HEADER CELL  (title + click-to-sort + per-column filter)
// ============================================================================
function _buildHeaderCell(col, schema) {
    var th = document.createElement('th');
    th.dataset.colKey = col.key;
    var required = (typeof col.required === 'function') ? false : !!col.required;

    // Click-to-sort row. 3-state toggle: unsorted -> asc -> desc -> unsorted.
    var btn = document.createElement('div');
    btn.className = 'col-header-btn';
    var nameSpan = document.createElement('span');
    nameSpan.innerHTML = '<span class="col-name">' + escapeHtml(col.key) + '</span>' +
        (required ? '<span class="col-required">*</span>' : '');
    // Per-column "remap source" icon button. Lives inside the nameSpan
    // so it sits visually with the column name, not the sort indicator.
    // `stopPropagation` on click prevents the wrapping col-header-btn
    // sort handler from firing — clicking the icon opens the popover,
    // not the sort toggle. The icon also gets its own mouseover/out
    // handlers that hide the rich tooltip while the popover is being
    // opened (otherwise both can appear simultaneously).
    var remapBtn = document.createElement('button');
    remapBtn.type = 'button';
    remapBtn.className = 'col-remap-btn';
    remapBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Remap source column for ' + col.key);
    // arrow-left-right (Lucide-style) — communicates "swap source".
    remapBtn.innerHTML =
        '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" ' +
        'stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">' +
        '<polyline points="17 3 21 7 17 11"/>' +
        '<line x1="21" y1="7" x2="3" y2="7"/>' +
        '<polyline points="7 21 3 17 7 13"/>' +
        '<line x1="3" y1="17" x2="21" y2="17"/>' +
        '</svg>';
    remapBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        hideAppTooltip();
        _openRemapPopover(remapBtn, col);
    });
    // Match the rich tooltip pattern on the icon too so users discover
    // what it does without clicking blind. Shorter than the column desc
    // — just enough to read intent.
    var remapTip = {
        title: 'Remap source',
        desc:  'Open a picker to redirect this column\'s mapping to a different source CSV column.',
        meta:  'Click to open · Current source visible inside'
    };
    remapBtn.addEventListener('mouseover', function (e) { showAppTooltip(e, remapTip); });
    remapBtn.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) { showAppTooltip(e, remapTip); });
    remapBtn.addEventListener('mouseout',  hideAppTooltip);
    nameSpan.appendChild(remapBtn);

    // Lock / freeze-first-column button. Only on the FIRST visible schema
    // column (PartNumber for PPVP, Name for Customer/Vendor). Clicking
    // toggles state.frozenFirstCol — every cell in the metadata band +
    // this column then gets `position: sticky; left: <cumulative px>`
    // applied so they stay pinned while the rest scrolls horizontally.
    if (col.key === _firstSchemaColKey()) {
        var lockBtn = document.createElement('button');
        lockBtn.type = 'button';
        lockBtn.className = 'col-lock-btn' + (state.frozenFirstCol ? ' active' : '');
        lockBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', state.frozenFirstCol
            ? 'Unfreeze ' + col.key + ' column' : 'Freeze ' + col.key + ' column');
        lockBtn.innerHTML = state.frozenFirstCol
            // Closed padlock — column is currently frozen.
            ? '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">' +
              '<rect x="4" y="11" width="16" height="10" rx="2"/>' +
              '<path d="M8 11V7a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v4"/>' +
              '</svg>'
            // Open padlock — column scrolls normally; click to freeze.
            : '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">' +
              '<rect x="4" y="11" width="16" height="10" rx="2"/>' +
              '<path d="M8 11V7a4 4 0 0 1 7.4-2"/>' +
              '</svg>';
        lockBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            hideAppTooltip();
            toggleFirstColLock();
        });
        var lockTip = {
            title: state.frozenFirstCol ? 'Unfreeze first column' : 'Freeze first column',
            desc:  state.frozenFirstCol
                ? 'Click to release the pinned columns and let them scroll with the rest of the table.'
                : 'Pin ' + col.key + ' + the row-metadata columns (select / delete / status / src#) to the left so they stay visible when you scroll horizontally — like Excel\'s Freeze First Column.',
            meta:  'Saved per-user'
        };
        lockBtn.addEventListener('mouseover', function (e) { showAppTooltip(e, lockTip); });
        lockBtn.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) { showAppTooltip(e, lockTip); });
        lockBtn.addEventListener('mouseout',  hideAppTooltip);
        nameSpan.appendChild(lockBtn);
    }

    btn.appendChild(nameSpan);
    var ind = document.createElement('span');
    ind.className = 'col-sort-indicator';
    if (state.sortCol === col.key) {
        ind.classList.add('active');
        ind.innerHTML = _sortIconSvg(state.sortDir === 'desc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
    } else {
        ind.innerHTML = _sortIconSvg('idle');
    }
    btn.appendChild(ind);
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () { _toggleSort(col.key); });

    // Rich tooltip — bound to the WHOLE header button (not just the name
    // span) so hovering anywhere on the title cell shows the same popover.
    // NOTE: we deliberately do NOT set `btn.title=…` here, because the
    // native browser tooltip would race the .app-tooltip popover and
    // appear in OS-default grey styling — which is the "old style" the
    // user was seeing. The sort-instructions hint is folded into the
    // rich tooltip's meta line instead, so the info stays available.
    var typeMeta = (col.type || 'Text') +
                   (col.maxLength ? ' · ' + col.maxLength + ' chars' : '') +
                   (col.vocab ? ' · vocab' : '');
    var sortHint = (state.sortCol === col.key)
        ? (state.sortDir === 'desc' ? 'Sorted ▼ — click to clear' : 'Sorted ▲ — click for ▼')
        : 'Click to sort ▲ / ▼';
    var ttPayload = {
        title:    col.key,
        required: required,
        desc:     col.desc || '',
        meta:     typeMeta + '  •  ' + sortHint
    };
    btn.addEventListener('mouseover', function (e) { showAppTooltip(e, ttPayload); });
    btn.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) { showAppTooltip(e, ttPayload); });
    btn.addEventListener('mouseout',  hideAppTooltip);

    th.appendChild(btn);

    // Type / length meta — visible at-a-glance below the column name.
    // Same text is also embedded in the nameSpan tooltip above, so users
    // who hover get the description AND the type info in one tooltip.
    var metaDiv = document.createElement('div');
    metaDiv.className = 'col-meta';
    metaDiv.textContent = (col.type || 'Text') + (col.maxLength ? ' · ' + col.maxLength : '');
    th.appendChild(metaDiv);

    // Per-column filter — select for vocab cols, text input for others.
    th.appendChild(_buildColumnFilter(col, schema));
    return th;
}

// The filter element itself. Options for vocab-controlled columns are drawn
// from VALUES ACTUALLY IN THE DATA (not the full vocab list) — for
// `existingVendors` the full list can be 1000+ items, but a single import
// only references a handful.
function _buildColumnFilter(col, schema) {
    var el;
    if (col.vocab) {
        el = document.createElement('select');
        var blank = document.createElement('option');
        blank.value = ''; blank.textContent = '(all)';
        el.appendChild(blank);
        _columnFilterOptions(col).forEach(function (o) {
            var op = document.createElement('option');
            op.value = o.value; op.textContent = o.label;
            el.appendChild(op);
        });
    } else {
        el = document.createElement('input');
        el.type = 'text';
        el.placeholder = 'Filter…';
    }
    el.className = 'col-filter';
    var cur = state.columnFilters && state.columnFilters[col.key];
    if (cur != null) el.value = cur;
    if (el.value) el.classList.add('has-value');
    setRichTip(el, {
        title: 'Filter ' + col.key,
        desc: col.vocab
            ? 'Pick a value to narrow rows to that exact match.'
            : 'Type a substring to narrow rows (case-insensitive).',
        meta: 'Display-only · does not change the exported CSV'
    });
    // Don't fire the parent's sort-toggle on clicks/focus inside the filter.
    el.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
    var apply = function () {
        var v = el.value;
        if (v) el.classList.add('has-value'); else el.classList.remove('has-value');
        state.columnFilters[col.key] = v;
        // Re-render body only. The filter input retains focus because the
        // header isn't touched.
        _renderBody(schema);
    };
    if (el.tagName === 'INPUT') {
        // Debounce text input so each keystroke doesn't re-render the body.
        el.addEventListener('input', debounce(apply, 180));
        el.addEventListener('change', apply);
    } else {
        el.addEventListener('change', apply);
    }
    return el;
}

function _columnFilterOptions(col) {
    var seen = Object.create(null);
    state.targetRows.forEach(function (r) {
        var v = r[col.key];
        if (v == null) return;
        var s = String(v);
        if (s.trim() === '') return;
        seen[s] = true;
    });
    // Decorate with vocab labels where available so e.g. AddressType reads
    // "50 - Main Office", not just "50".
    var labelMap = {};
    if (col.vocab) {
        var vocab = vocabOptions(col.vocab) || [];
        vocab.forEach(function (o) { labelMap[String(o.value).toLowerCase()] = o.label; });
    }
    var keys = Object.keys(seen).sort(function (a, b) {
        return a.toLowerCase() < b.toLowerCase() ? -1 : 1;
    });
    return keys.map(function (v) {
        var lbl = labelMap[v.toLowerCase()] || v;
        return { value: v, label: lbl };
    });
}

// ============================================================================
// BODY RENDER  (sort + filter + lazy-append on scroll)
// ----
// Building 5000+ trs with 40+ cells each up-front would freeze the page
// for several seconds AND keep tens of thousands of <select>/<input>
// elements in the DOM (each carrying its own event listeners). Instead
// we render the first LAZY_INITIAL rows synchronously, stash the full
// filtered-and-sorted item list on state, and append further chunks of
