// LAZY_CHUNK rows whenever the user scrolls within LAZY_NEAR_BOTTOM_PX
// of the bottom of the container. The full dataset stays in
// state.targetRows so cell-edit handlers, validation, and export are
// completely unaffected.
// ============================================================================
var LAZY_INITIAL = 200;
var LAZY_CHUNK = 200;
var LAZY_NEAR_BOTTOM_PX = 600;

function _renderBody(schema) {
    var body = document.getElementById('resultsTableBody');
    body.innerHTML = '';

    var items = _visibleItemsAfterFilters(schema);

    if (state.sortCol) {
        var sortCol = state.sortCol;
        var dir = state.sortDir === 'desc' ? -1 : 1;
        items.sort(function (a, b) {
            return _compareForSort(a.row[sortCol], b.row[sortCol]) * dir;
        });
    }

    // Stash for lazy-append on scroll. _renderedCount tracks how many of
    // the stashed items have actually been rendered into DOM so far.
    state._lazyItems = items;
    state._lazyRenderedCount = 0;
    state._lazySchema = schema;

    if (!items.length) {
        var emptyTr = document.createElement('tr');
        var td = document.createElement('td');
        var errorColumnKeys = state._visibleColKeys;
        var visibleSchemaCols = errorColumnKeys
            ? _visibleColumns(schema).filter(function (c) { return errorColumnKeys.has(c.key); }).length
            : _visibleColumns(schema).length;
        // +4 metadata columns: select / delete / status / src#.
        td.colSpan = visibleSchemaCols + 4;
        td.style.cssText = 'padding:20px; text-align:center; color:#94a3b8; font-style:italic;';
        // Distinguish "you have no data" from "your filters hid everything"
        // so the user knows to clear filters rather than re-upload.
        var showOnlyIssues = !!document.getElementById('filterIssuesOnly').checked;
        var dupesChk = document.getElementById('filterDupesOnly');
        var showOnlyDupes = !!(dupesChk && dupesChk.checked);
        var hasActiveFilter = state.sortCol
            || showOnlyIssues || showOnlyDupes
            || state.kpiFilter
            || Object.keys(state.columnFilters || {}).some(function (k) { return !!state.columnFilters[k]; });
        td.textContent = (state.targetRows.length && hasActiveFilter)
            ? 'No rows match the current filters — ' + state.targetRows.length + ' row(s) hidden. Clear column filters or the "Only Show…" checkboxes to see them.'
            : 'No rows to display.';
        emptyTr.appendChild(td); body.appendChild(emptyTr);
        _updateLazyStatus();
        _updateHeaderSelectCheckbox();
        _updateBulkDeleteButton();
        updateFiltersButtonLabel();
        return;
    }

    _appendNextLazyChunk(LAZY_INITIAL);
    _ensureLazyScrollHook();
    _updateLazyStatus();

    // Reset scroll to top after a re-render so the user sees the first
    // chunk (a stale scrollTop from a previous, longer item list would
    // otherwise leave them looking at empty space).
    var container = document.getElementById('resultsTableContainer');
    if (container) container.scrollTop = 0;

    _updateHeaderSelectCheckbox();
    _updateBulkDeleteButton();
    updateFiltersButtonLabel();
}

// Append the next `count` items from state._lazyItems to the tbody. Reads
// state._lazyRenderedCount as the cursor and bumps it forward. Uses a
// DocumentFragment so the browser only does one layout per chunk.
function _appendNextLazyChunk(count) {
    var body = document.getElementById('resultsTableBody');
    var items = state._lazyItems;
    var schema = state._lazySchema || FB_SCHEMAS[state.targetKind];
    if (!body || !items || !items.length) return;
    var start = state._lazyRenderedCount || 0;
    if (start >= items.length) return;
    var end = Math.min(items.length, start + count);
    var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    for (var i = start; i < end; i++) {
        frag.appendChild(_buildBodyRow(items[i].row, items[i].idx, schema));
    }
    body.appendChild(frag);
    state._lazyRenderedCount = end;
    _updateLazyStatus();
    // Header checkbox tri-state depends on visible-vs-selected — refresh.
    _updateHeaderSelectCheckbox();
    // No need to re-run _applyFrozenColumns here: the new freeze CSS
    // uses :nth-child + variables on the table itself, so any newly
    // appended row automatically inherits the sticky positioning.
}

// One-time wire: scroll listener on the table container that appends the
// next chunk when the user is near the bottom. The listener stays attached
// across re-renders (idempotent via `_lazyHooked`) — _renderBody resets
// state._lazyRenderedCount so the same listener picks up the new list.
function _ensureLazyScrollHook() {
    var c = document.getElementById('resultsTableContainer');
    if (!c || c._lazyHooked) return;
    c._lazyHooked = true;
    var ticking = false;
    c.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
        if (ticking) return;
        ticking = true;
        requestAnimationFrame(function () {
            ticking = false;
            if (!state._lazyItems) return;
            if (state._lazyRenderedCount >= state._lazyItems.length) return;
            var near = (c.scrollHeight - c.scrollTop - c.clientHeight) < LAZY_NEAR_BOTTOM_PX;
            if (near) _appendNextLazyChunk(LAZY_CHUNK);
        });
    });
}

// Reflects "showing X of Y" in the results subtitle when the list has been
// truncated by lazy rendering. updateSummaryStats() also writes to this
// element; we read its current content and only update the trailing
// "showing…" suffix so the two writers don't clobber each other.
function _updateLazyStatus() {
    var sub = document.getElementById('resultsSubtitle');
    if (!sub) return;
    var rendered = state._lazyRenderedCount || 0;
    var total    = state._lazyItems ? state._lazyItems.length : 0;
    // Strip any previous "· showing …" suffix from prior updates.
    var base = (sub.textContent || '').replace(/\s*·\s*Showing[^·]*$/i, '');
    if (total > 0 && rendered < total) {
        sub.textContent = base + ' · Showing ' + rendered.toLocaleString() +
            ' of ' + total.toLocaleString() + ' (scroll for more)';
    } else if (total > 0 && rendered === total && state.targetRows.length > rendered) {
        // After applying a filter the rendered set may equal the filtered
        // total but still be less than the underlying row count. Tell the
        // user the table is fully drawn for the active filter view.
        sub.textContent = base + ' · Showing ' + total.toLocaleString() +
            ' of ' + total.toLocaleString();
    } else {
        sub.textContent = base;
    }
}

function _matchesColumnFilters(row, schema) {
    if (!state.columnFilters) return true;
    var keys = Object.keys(state.columnFilters);
    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
        var k = keys[i];
        var f = state.columnFilters[k];
        if (f == null || String(f).trim() === '') continue;
        var v = row[k]; if (v == null) v = '';
        var sv = String(v).toLowerCase();
        var sf = String(f).trim().toLowerCase();
        var col = schema.columns.find(function (c) { return c.key === k; });
        var isVocab = !!(col && col.vocab);
        if (isVocab) {
            // Dropdown filter writes the exact stored value -> exact match.
            if (sv !== sf) return false;
        } else {
            // Text-input filter -> case-insensitive substring.
            if (sv.indexOf(sf) === -1) return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

// Comparator used by the body sort. Empties always sort to the END (caller
// won't flip them with the asc/desc multiplier — they return +/-1 in
// absolute terms). Numeric compare only when BOTH sides parse as pure
// numbers, so Price sorts numerically but PartNumber sorts lexically.
function _compareForSort(a, b) {
    if (a == null) a = '';
    if (b == null) b = '';
    var sa = String(a).trim();
    var sb = String(b).trim();
    if (sa === '' && sb !== '') return 1;
    if (sa !== '' && sb === '') return -1;
    if (sa === '' && sb === '') return 0;
    var nRe = /^-?\d*\.?\d+$/;
    if (nRe.test(sa) && nRe.test(sb)) {
        return parseFloat(sa) - parseFloat(sb);
    }
    var la = sa.toLowerCase();
    var lb = sb.toLowerCase();
    if (la < lb) return -1;
    if (la > lb) return  1;
    return 0;
}

// 3-state toggle: unsorted -> asc -> desc -> unsorted. Only the indicator
// + body order need to change, so we update the indicator in place and
// re-render the body (preserving any focused filter input).
function _toggleSort(colKey) {
    if (state.sortCol !== colKey) {
        state.sortCol = colKey;
        state.sortDir = 'asc';
    } else if (state.sortDir === 'asc') {
        state.sortDir = 'desc';
    } else {
        state.sortCol = null;
        state.sortDir = 'asc';
    }
    _refreshSortIndicators();
    _renderBody(FB_SCHEMAS[state.targetKind]);
}

function _refreshSortIndicators() {
    var headerRow = document.getElementById('resultsHeaderRow');
    if (!headerRow) return;
    var ths = headerRow.querySelectorAll('th[data-col-key]');
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(ths, function (th) {
        var key = th.dataset.colKey;
        var ind = th.querySelector('.col-sort-indicator');
        if (!ind) return;
        if (state.sortCol === key) {
            ind.classList.add('active');
            ind.innerHTML = _sortIconSvg(state.sortDir === 'desc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        } else {
            ind.classList.remove('active');
            ind.innerHTML = _sortIconSvg('idle');
        }
    });
}

// ============================================================================
// FILTERS DROPDOWN  (multi-select popover in the toolbar)
// ============================================================================
// Wraps the three "Only Show…" checkboxes in a single trigger so the
// toolbar stays compact. The underlying inputs still carry their original
// IDs (filterIssuesOnly / filterErrorColsOnly / filterDupesOnly) so every
// other site that reads them keeps working without changes.

function toggleFiltersPopover(e) {
    if (e) e.stopPropagation();
    var dd = document.getElementById('filtersDropdown');
    if (!dd) return;
    var wasOpen = dd.classList.contains('open');
    dd.classList.toggle('open');
    if (!wasOpen) {
        // Defer the outside-click listener attach so the click that opened
        // the popover doesn't immediately re-close it.
        setTimeout(function () {
            document.addEventListener('click', _filtersOutsideClick);
        }, 0);
    } else {
        document.removeEventListener('click', _filtersOutsideClick);
    }
}

function _filtersOutsideClick(e) {
    var dd = document.getElementById('filtersDropdown');
    if (!dd) {
        document.removeEventListener('click', _filtersOutsideClick);
        return;
    }
    if (!dd.contains(e.target)) {
        dd.classList.remove('open');
        document.removeEventListener('click', _filtersOutsideClick);
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// PER-COLUMN REMAP POPOVER
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Triggered by the small arrow-swap icon next to each column header name.
// Lets the user redirect a target column's source mapping without going
// back to the field-mapping modal. The popover is a single floating div
// positioned to the icon; closed by Apply / Cancel / Esc / outside-click.
//
// On Apply, we re-derive ONLY that column for every target row, pulling
// from the new source column via _mappedValue. We deliberately DON'T re-run
// the source profile's transformRow — that would clobber other columns the
// user may have already hand-edited. The trade-off: any per-column
// transforms baked into transformRow (Shopify weight g→kg, stripHtml on
// PartDetails, yes/no→true/false on TaxExempt, etc.) are NOT re-applied
// when remapping that column. For columns that need transforms, the user
// should fix them via the cell-edit / bulk-overwrite controls or
// re-process the source via the mapping modal.
// ============================================================================
var _activeRemapPopover = null;

function _openRemapPopover(anchorEl, col) {
    _closeRemapPopover();
    if (!state.sourceHeaders.length) {
        showMessage('No source CSV loaded — nothing to remap from.', 'warn');
        return;
    }

    var pop = document.createElement('div');
    pop.className = 'col-remap-popover';

    var currentMapping = _mappingCols(state.fieldMappings[col.key]);
    var currentPrimary = currentMapping[0] || '';
    var currentLabel = currentMapping.length
        ? (currentMapping.length === 1
            ? currentPrimary
            : currentMapping.join(' + '))
        : '(none)';

    pop.innerHTML =
        '<div class="crp-label">Remap source for</div>' +
        '<div class="crp-title">' + escapeHtml(col.key) +
            (col.required ? ' <span style="color:#ef4444;">*</span>' : '') +
            '</div>' +
        '<div class="crp-current">Currently mapped from: <code>' +
            escapeHtml(currentLabel) + '</code></div>';

    var sel = document.createElement('select');
    var none = document.createElement('option');
    none.value = ''; none.textContent = '(None — leave blank)';
    sel.appendChild(none);
    state.sourceHeaders.forEach(function (h) {
        var o = document.createElement('option');
        o.value = h; o.textContent = h;
        if (h === currentPrimary) o.selected = true;
        sel.appendChild(o);
    });
    pop.appendChild(sel);

    var actions = document.createElement('div');
    actions.className = 'crp-actions';
    var cancel = document.createElement('button');
    cancel.type = 'button'; cancel.className = 'btn btn-sm';
    cancel.textContent = 'Cancel';
    cancel.addEventListener('click', _closeRemapPopover);
    var apply = document.createElement('button');
    apply.type = 'button'; apply.className = 'btn btn-sm btn-primary';
    apply.textContent = 'Apply';
    apply.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var newSrc = sel.value;
        _closeRemapPopover();
        _applyRemap(col.key, newSrc);
    });
    actions.appendChild(cancel);
    actions.appendChild(apply);
    pop.appendChild(actions);

    document.body.appendChild(pop);
    _activeRemapPopover = pop;

    // Position relative to the icon. `position: fixed` so viewport
    // coords are used directly. If the popover would overflow the
    // viewport's right edge, snap it to the right side; same for
    // bottom — flip above the icon.
    var rect = anchorEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    var pw = pop.offsetWidth, ph = pop.offsetHeight;
    var vw = window.innerWidth, vh = window.innerHeight;
    var left = rect.left;
    var top  = rect.bottom + 4;
    if (left + pw + 12 > vw) left = Math.max(8, vw - pw - 12);
    if (top + ph + 12 > vh)  top  = Math.max(8, rect.top - ph - 4);
    pop.style.left = left + 'px';
    pop.style.top  = top  + 'px';

    // Focus the select so the user can immediately type / arrow-key.
    sel.focus();

    // Esc closes; outside-click closes. Listeners attached on next tick
    // so the click that opened the popover doesn't immediately re-close it.
    setTimeout(function () {
        document.addEventListener('click', _remapOutsideClick);
        document.addEventListener('keydown', _remapKeyHandler);
    }, 0);
}

function _closeRemapPopover() {
    if (_activeRemapPopover && _activeRemapPopover.parentNode) {
        _activeRemapPopover.parentNode.removeChild(_activeRemapPopover);
    }
    _activeRemapPopover = null;
    document.removeEventListener('click', _remapOutsideClick);
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', _remapKeyHandler);
}

function _remapOutsideClick(e) {
    if (!_activeRemapPopover) return;
    if (!_activeRemapPopover.contains(e.target)) _closeRemapPopover();
}

function _remapKeyHandler(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        _closeRemapPopover();
    }
}

function _applyRemap(targetCol, newSource) {
    // Update the persistent mapping so future re-processings honour it,
    // and so the mapping modal reflects the change if the user opens it.
    var prevMapping = state.fieldMappings[targetCol];
    state.fieldMappings[targetCol] = newSource || '';

    if (!state.targetRows.length || !state.sourceRows.length) {
        debugLog('Remap: nothing to re-derive (no source or target rows)', 'warn');
        return;
    }

    // Index source rows by _sourceRowNum so the per-target-row lookup is O(1).
    var sourceByNum = Object.create(null);
    state.sourceRows.forEach(function (sr) { sourceByNum[sr._sourceRowNum] = sr; });

    // Re-derive the column for every target row + collect bulk-history
    // entries so the whole remap reverses in a single Ctrl+Z.
    var changes = [];
    state.targetRows.forEach(function (r, idx) {
        var sr = sourceByNum[r._sourceRowNum];
        var newVal = '';
        if (sr && newSource) {
            var v = _mappedValue(sr, newSource);
            if (v != null) newVal = String(v);
        }
        var oldVal = r[targetCol];
        var oldStr = (oldVal == null) ? '' : String(oldVal);
        if (oldStr === newVal) return;
        changes.push({ rowIdx: idx, colKey: targetCol, oldValue: oldVal, newValue: newVal });
        r[targetCol] = newVal;
    });
    if (changes.length) {
        History.push({
            type: 'bulk',
            label: 'remap ' + targetCol + ' ← ' + (newSource || '(none)'),
            changes: changes
        });
    }
    debugLog('Remap: ' + targetCol + ' ← ' + (newSource || '(none)') +
             ' — ' + changes.length + ' row(s) changed (prev source: ' +
             (Array.isArray(prevMapping) ? prevMapping.join(' + ') : (prevMapping || '(none)')) + ')',
             'success');
    if (changes.length) {
        showMessage('Remapped ' + targetCol + ' to ' + (newSource || '(none)') +
                    ' · ' + changes.length + ' row(s) updated', 'success');
    } else {
        showMessage('Remap had no effect — every row already matched the new source.', 'info');
    }
    validateAllRows();
    renderResultsTable();
}

// Single checkbox-change handler — keeps the label/highlight in sync with
// the actual filter state and triggers a body re-render. Replaces the
// previous direct onchange="renderResultsTable()" wiring so the trigger
// button stays accurate.
function onDisplayFilterChange() {
    updateFiltersButtonLabel();
    renderResultsTable();
}

function updateFiltersButtonLabel() {
    var lbl = document.getElementById('filtersBtnLabel');
    var btn = document.getElementById('filtersToggleBtn');
    if (!lbl || !btn) return;
    var count = 0;
    // Iterate only the filters that are CURRENTLY VISIBLE — the dupes
    // checkbox is schema-conditional, and an unchecked-because-hidden
    // dupes filter shouldn't be counted. Easiest tell: the wrapper
    // <label> has display:none when hidden.
    ['filterIssuesOnly', 'filterErrorColsOnly', 'filterDupesOnly'].forEach(function (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!el || !el.checked) return;
        var lblEl = el.closest('label');
        if (lblEl && lblEl.style.display === 'none') return;
        count++;
    });
    lbl.textContent = count ? 'Filters (' + count + ')' : 'Filters';
    btn.classList.toggle('filters-active', count > 0);
}

// ============================================================================
// BULK SELECT + DELETE
// ============================================================================
// Compute the rows that pass all active filters (issues-only, dupes-only,
// per-column filters), preserving the ORIGINAL targetRows index so the
// cell-edit / drag-drop / delete handlers (which address rows by array
// position) keep working when the display is sorted.
function _visibleItemsAfterFilters(schema) {
    var showOnlyIssues = !!document.getElementById('filterIssuesOnly').checked;
    var dupesChk = document.getElementById('filterDupesOnly');
    var showOnlyDupes = !!(dupesChk && dupesChk.checked);
    var kpiFilter = state.kpiFilter;
    var items = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < state.targetRows.length; i++) {
        var row = state.targetRows[i];
        if (showOnlyIssues && row._status === 'ready') continue;
        if (showOnlyDupes && !_rowHasDuplicate(row, schema)) continue;
        // KPI filter — only rows with at least one cell tagged with the
        // active kind survive. AND-combined with the other filters above
        // so a user can stack (e.g.) "only issues" + "missing-vendor".
        if (kpiFilter && !_rowHasIssueKind(row, kpiFilter)) continue;
        if (!_matchesColumnFilters(row, schema)) continue;
        items.push({ row: row, idx: i });
    }
    return items;
}

// Header checkbox tri-state: unchecked when 0 visible rows are selected,
// checked when ALL visible rows are selected, indeterminate otherwise.
// Disabled (and unchecked) when no rows are visible.
function _updateHeaderSelectCheckbox() {
    var cb = document.getElementById('headerSelectAll');
    if (!cb) return;
    var visible = _visibleItemsAfterFilters(FB_SCHEMAS[state.targetKind]);
    if (!visible.length) {
        cb.checked = false; cb.indeterminate = false; cb.disabled = true;
        return;
    }
    cb.disabled = false;
    var sel = 0;
    visible.forEach(function (it) { if (state.selectedRows.has(it.row)) sel++; });
    if (sel === 0)                      { cb.checked = false; cb.indeterminate = false; }
    else if (sel === visible.length)    { cb.checked = true;  cb.indeterminate = false; }
    else                                 { cb.checked = false; cb.indeterminate = true;  }
}

// Bulk-delete button label/disabled state. Count is the FULL selection
// size (not just visible+selected) — the user can apply a filter, select
// all visible, change the filter, select more, then delete the union.
function _updateBulkDeleteButton() {
    var btn = document.getElementById('bulkDeleteBtn');
    var lbl = document.getElementById('bulkDeleteLabel');
    if (!btn || !lbl) return;
    var n = state.selectedRows.size;
    btn.disabled = (n === 0);
    lbl.textContent = (n === 0) ? 'Delete selected' : ('Delete ' + n + ' selected');
}

// Header-checkbox onchange: when ALL visible are selected, click deselects
// all visible; otherwise, click selects all visible. Selection of HIDDEN
// rows is untouched — they keep whatever state they had, which is the
// right behaviour for refine-with-filter workflows.
function _toggleSelectAllVisible() {
    var schema = FB_SCHEMAS[state.targetKind];
    var visible = _visibleItemsAfterFilters(schema);
    if (!visible.length) return;
    var allSelected = visible.every(function (it) { return state.selectedRows.has(it.row); });
    if (allSelected) {
        visible.forEach(function (it) { state.selectedRows.delete(it.row); });
    } else {
        visible.forEach(function (it) { state.selectedRows.add(it.row); });
    }
    // Re-render body to refresh row checkboxes + .row-selected wash;
    // the header checkbox state is updated inside _renderBody.
    _renderBody(schema);
}

function bulkDeleteSelected() {
    var n = state.selectedRows.size;
    if (!n) return;
    ConfirmModal.show({
        title: 'Delete ' + n + ' selected row' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's') + '?',
        body: '<p>This will permanently remove ' + n + ' row' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's') +
              ' from the import. The source CSV file is not changed; you can undo this with Ctrl+Z (one step).</p>' +
              '<p style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:11px; margin-top:8px;">Selected rows include any currently hidden by filters.</p>',
        okLabel: 'Delete ' + n + ' row' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's'),
        danger: true
    }).then(function (confirmed) {
        if (!confirmed) return;
        _performBulkDelete();
    });
}

function _performBulkDelete() {
    // Collect {idx, row} for rows that are BOTH in the selection AND still
    // in state.targetRows (the per-row delete button could have removed
    // one in the meantime; guard against that). Splice in descending-idx
    // order so each splice doesn't shift later indices we still need.
    var items = [];
    state.targetRows.forEach(function (row, idx) {
        if (state.selectedRows.has(row)) items.push({ idx: idx, row: row });
    });
    if (!items.length) {
        state.selectedRows.clear();
        _updateBulkDeleteButton();
        return;
    }
    items.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return b.idx - a.idx; })
        .forEach(function (it) { state.targetRows.splice(it.idx, 1); });
    // One history entry for the whole batch -> one Ctrl+Z restores all.
    History.push({ type: 'bulkdelete', items: items });
    state.selectedRows.clear();
    debugLog('Bulk-deleted ' + items.length + ' row(s)', 'info');
    showMessage('Deleted ' + items.length + ' row' + (items.length === 1 ? '' : 's'), 'success');
    validateAllRows();
    renderResultsTable();
}

function _th(label, cls) {
    var th = document.createElement('th');
    if (cls) th.className = cls;
    th.textContent = label;
    return th;
}

function _buildBulkControl(col) {
    // Two stacked rows per column, each carrying ONE scope dropdown +
    // ONE Apply button (reduced clutter vs the earlier two-buttons-per-row
    // layout). The scope options differ:
    //   - Row A (typed value):  Fill empty / Overwrite all / Overwrite errors
    //   - Row B (copy column):  Fill empty / Overwrite errors
    // "Overwrite errors" only writes to cells where the column currently
    // has a hard validation issue, which is the most common reason for
    // bulk-editing (clean up the highlighted reds in one click).
    var wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.style.cssText = 'display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px;';

    // ---- Row A: value-driven set ----
    var rowA = document.createElement('div');
    rowA.style.cssText = 'display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto auto; gap:3px; align-items:center;';

    var input;
    var opts = col.vocab ? vocabOptions(col.vocab) : null;
    if (opts && opts.length) {
        input = document.createElement('select');
        // Same lazy-populate threshold as the per-cell selects: big
        // vocabs (>50) only render the placeholder up-front and
        // populate the full list on first focus. Bulk-row selects are
        // ONE per column (~30 columns) — small change in raw numbers
        // vs the body cells, but avoids the worst-case 10k+ extra
        // options getting built every time the user toggles a target.
        if (opts.length > 50) {
            _initLazyVocabSelect(input, opts, '');
        } else {
            _populateVocabSelect(input, opts, '');
        }
    } else {
        input = document.createElement('input');
        input.type = 'text';
        input.placeholder = 'Value to set';
    }
    input.dataset.bulkField = col.key;

    var scopeA = document.createElement('select');
    scopeA.className = 'bulk-scope-select';
    setRichTip(scopeA, { title: 'Apply scope', desc: 'Choose which rows the ✓ button affects:\n• Fill empty — only blank cells\n• Overwrite all — every row\n• Overwrite errors — only rows where this column has a hard validation issue', meta: col.key });
    [
        { v: 'empty',  t: 'Fill empty' },
        { v: 'all',    t: 'Overwrite all' },
        { v: 'errors', t: 'Overwrite errors' }
    ].forEach(function (o) {
        var op = document.createElement('option');
        op.value = o.v; op.textContent = o.t;
        scopeA.appendChild(op);
    });

    var applyA = document.createElement('button');
    applyA.type = 'button';
    applyA.className = 'bulk-apply-btn bulk-apply-tick';
    applyA.innerHTML = '✓';   // U+2713 CHECK MARK
    setRichTip(applyA, { title: 'Apply value', desc: 'Write the value typed/picked above into every row matching the scope dropdown. One undo step (Ctrl+Z) reverses the whole batch.', meta: col.key });
    applyA.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Apply value');
    applyA.addEventListener('click', function () {
        applyBulkOverwrite(col.key, input.value, scopeA.value);
    });

    rowA.appendChild(input);
    rowA.appendChild(scopeA);
    rowA.appendChild(applyA);

    // ---- Row B: copy from another target column ----
    var rowB = document.createElement('div');
    rowB.style.cssText = 'display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto auto; gap:3px; align-items:center;';

    var copySel = document.createElement('select');
    setRichTip(copySel, { title: 'Copy from column', desc: 'Pick another target column. The ✓ button below will copy that column\'s value into this column for every row matching the scope dropdown.', meta: 'Target: ' + col.key });
    var copyBlank = document.createElement('option');
    copyBlank.value = ''; copyBlank.textContent = 'Copy from column…';
    copySel.appendChild(copyBlank);
    var schema = FB_SCHEMAS[state.targetKind];
    _visibleColumns(schema).forEach(function (c) {
        if (c.key === col.key) return;   // can't copy a column from itself
        var o = document.createElement('option');
        o.value = c.key; o.textContent = c.key;
        copySel.appendChild(o);
    });

    var scopeB = document.createElement('select');
    scopeB.className = 'bulk-scope-select';
    setRichTip(scopeB, { title: 'Copy scope', desc: 'Choose which rows the copy affects:\n• Fill empty — only blank cells in this column\n• Overwrite errors — only rows where this column has a hard validation issue', meta: col.key });
    // Copy-from intentionally omits "Overwrite all" — copying a column
    // wholesale is rarely what the user wants; if they need that they can
    // do "Overwrite all" with a typed value on Row A. Keeping it to two
    // options also reads as "I want to repair the broken bits", which is
    // the actual use case.
    [
        { v: 'empty',  t: 'Fill empty' },
        { v: 'errors', t: 'Overwrite errors' }
    ].forEach(function (o) {
        var op = document.createElement('option');
        op.value = o.v; op.textContent = o.t;
        scopeB.appendChild(op);
    });

    var applyB = document.createElement('button');
    applyB.type = 'button';
    applyB.className = 'bulk-apply-btn bulk-apply-tick';
    applyB.innerHTML = '✓';   // U+2713 CHECK MARK
    setRichTip(applyB, { title: 'Apply copy', desc: 'Run the copy-from-column action with the scope selected above. One undo step (Ctrl+Z) reverses the whole batch.', meta: col.key });
    applyB.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Apply copy');
    // Cyan accent distinguishes the copy-from action from the value-set action.
    applyB.style.cssText = 'background:#0ea5e9; border-color:#0284c7;';
    applyB.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (!copySel.value) { showMessage('Pick a source column first', 'warn'); return; }
        applyCopyFromColumn(col.key, copySel.value, scopeB.value);
    });

    rowB.appendChild(copySel);
    rowB.appendChild(scopeB);
    rowB.appendChild(applyB);

    wrap.appendChild(rowA);
    wrap.appendChild(rowB);
    return wrap;
}

// Returns true if `row` has a hard cell-issue for `field` (used by the
// "Overwrite errors" scope). Warnings deliberately don't count — they're
// informational, not "this value is wrong and needs fixing".
function _hasError(row, field) {
    return !!(row._cellIssues && row._cellIssues[field]);
}

// Per-row delete — confirmation-gated. Identifies the row by its first
// non-empty "natural key" field (Name for Customer/Vendor, PartNumber for
// PPVP, falling back to source-row index) so the prompt is meaningful even
// when the table has been filtered or re-sorted.
function promptDeleteRow(row) {
    var schema = FB_SCHEMAS[state.targetKind];
    // Find a value the user is likely to recognise. Walk the schema in
    // declared order and pick the first required column that's populated,
    // else the first column with any value.
    var identCol = null, identVal = null;
    var idCols = _visibleColumns(schema);
    for (var i = 0; i < idCols.length; i++) {
        var col = idCols[i];
        var req = (typeof col.required === 'function') ? false : !!col.required;
        if (req && row[col.key]) { identCol = col.key; identVal = row[col.key]; break; }
    }
    if (!identVal) {
        for (var j = 0; j < idCols.length; j++) {
            var c = idCols[j];
            if (row[c.key] != null && String(row[c.key]).trim() !== '') {
                identCol = c.key; identVal = row[c.key]; break;
            }
        }
    }
    var snippet = identVal
        ? '<strong>' + escapeHtml(identCol) + ':</strong> ' + escapeHtml(String(identVal).slice(0, 80))
        : '<em>(empty row from source line ' + row._sourceRowNum + ')</em>';

    ConfirmModal.show({
        title: 'Delete this row?',
        body: '<p>This will permanently remove the row from the import. The source CSV file is not changed.</p>' +
              '<p style="background:#f8fafc; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:6px; padding:8px 10px; margin-top:8px;">' + snippet + '</p>' +
              '<p style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:11px; margin-top:8px;">Tip: to bulk-clean rows, use the "Show only rows with issues" filter and delete one at a time, or reload the source CSV to start over.</p>',
        okLabel: 'Delete row',
        danger: true
    }).then(function (confirmed) {
        if (!confirmed) return;
        deleteRow(row);
    });
}

function deleteRow(row) {
    var idx = state.targetRows.indexOf(row);
    if (idx === -1) {
        debugLog('deleteRow: row not found in state.targetRows — ignoring', 'warn');
        return;
    }
    state.targetRows.splice(idx, 1);
    // Drop from selection so the bulk-delete count doesn't include this
    // already-deleted row. Undo of the per-row delete reinserts the row
    // (same object identity) but the user would need to re-select it.
    state.selectedRows.delete(row);
    // Snapshot the deleted row in the history entry so undo can re-insert
    // it verbatim. The row is a plain object so identity-equality on undo
    // is fine — we don't deep-clone the contents.
    History.push({ type: 'delete', rowIdx: idx, row: row });
    debugLog('Deleted row (source line ' + row._sourceRowNum + ')', 'info');
    showMessage('Row deleted', 'success');
    // Full revalidate — deleting one of two duplicates makes the surviving
    // sibling unique again, so its cell-issue needs to clear.
    validateAllRows();
    renderResultsTable();
}

// Decide whether a row should be touched by a bulk operation given the scope.
//   scope = 'empty'  → only when the target cell is empty
//   scope = 'all'    → always (value-set only; copy-from omits this scope)
//   scope = 'errors' → only when the target cell has a hard validation issue
function _scopeMatches(row, field, scope) {
    var cur = row[field];
    var isEmpty = (cur == null || String(cur).trim() === '');
    if (scope === 'all')    return true;
    if (scope === 'errors') return _hasError(row, field);
    return isEmpty;   // default 'empty'
}

// Per-row copy: target[colKey] := target[sourceColKey] for every row that
// matches the scope. Used by the "Copy from column" affordance in the
// bulk-overwrite strip. Pushes a bulk action to history so it can be undone
// in a single Ctrl+Z.
function applyCopyFromColumn(targetKey, sourceKey, scope) {
    if (targetKey === sourceKey) return;
    var schema = FB_SCHEMAS[state.targetKind];
    var changes = [];
    state.targetRows.forEach(function (r, idx) {
        if (!_scopeMatches(r, targetKey, scope)) return;
        var src = r[sourceKey];
        if (src == null || String(src).trim() === '') return;
        var newVal = String(src);
        if (r[targetKey] === newVal) return;   // no-op skip
        changes.push({ rowIdx: idx, colKey: targetKey, oldValue: r[targetKey], newValue: newVal });
        r[targetKey] = newVal;
    });
    debugLog('Copy-from-column (' + scope + '): ' + targetKey + ' ← ' + sourceKey + ' applied to ' + changes.length + ' row(s)', 'info');
    if (changes.length) {
        History.push({ type: 'bulk', label: 'copy ' + sourceKey + ' → ' + targetKey, changes: changes });
    }
    showMessage('Copied ' + sourceKey + ' → ' + targetKey + ' on ' + changes.length + ' row(s)', 'success');
    // Full revalidate (not per-row) so the duplicate-PartNumber set is
    // recomputed — copying a column wholesale can introduce or resolve
    // dupes across many rows at once.
    validateAllRows();
    renderResultsTable();
}

function applyBulkOverwrite(field, value, scope) {
    var schema = FB_SCHEMAS[state.targetKind];
    // Normalise Decimal / Numeric bulk values up-front so the column gets
    // clean numbers (and a single typed "$1,234.50" doesn't end up in every
    // empty cell as a validation failure).
    var colDef = schema.columns.find(function (c) { return c.key === field; });
    if (colDef && (colDef.type === 'Decimal' || colDef.type === 'Numeric') && value != null && String(value).trim() !== '') {
        var nrm = normalizeDecimal(value);
        if (nrm !== null) value = nrm;
    }
    var changes = [];
    state.targetRows.forEach(function (r, idx) {
        if (!_scopeMatches(r, field, scope)) return;
        if (r[field] === value) return;   // no-op skip
        changes.push({ rowIdx: idx, colKey: field, oldValue: r[field], newValue: value });
        r[field] = value;
    });
    debugLog('Bulk-overwrite (' + scope + '): ' + field + ' = "' + value + '" applied to ' + changes.length + ' row(s)', 'info');
    if (changes.length) {
        History.push({ type: 'bulk', label: 'set ' + field + ' (' + scope + ')', changes: changes });
    }
    showMessage('Set ' + field + ' on ' + changes.length + ' row(s)', 'success');
    // Full revalidate so the duplicate-PartNumber map stays current — a
    // bulk-overwrite of PartNumber would otherwise leave the old dupe set
    // stale.
    validateAllRows();
    renderResultsTable();
}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Lazy / eager vocab-cell populate helpers — both used by _buildBodyRow.
//
// _populateVocabSelect(sel, opts, currentValStr): fills `sel` with the
//   blank placeholder + every entry in `opts`, marks the matching one
//   selected, surfaces unknown values with a red "Unknown: <val>" entry.
//   This is the SYNCHRONOUS build path — used for short vocabs (≤50
//   options) where the construction cost is trivial.
//
// _initLazyVocabSelect(sel, opts, currentValStr): leaves `sel` with
//   only the placeholder + (if non-empty) the current value pre-selected.
//   The full options aren't built yet. On the FIRST focus event the
//   actual build happens. This is the LAZY path — used for big vocabs
//   (>50 options) so that initial-render cost stays bounded regardless
//   of how many vendors / customers / payment terms etc. are in the
//   live Fishbowl database.
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function _populateVocabSelect(sel, opts, currentValStr) {
    var blank = document.createElement('option');
    blank.value = ''; blank.textContent = '(blank)';
    sel.appendChild(blank);
    var matched = false;
    var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    for (var i = 0; i < opts.length; i++) {
        var o = opts[i];
        var op = document.createElement('option');
        op.value = o.value; op.textContent = o.label;
        if (String(o.value).toLowerCase() === currentValStr.toLowerCase()
         || String(o.label).toLowerCase() === currentValStr.toLowerCase()) {
            op.selected = true; matched = true;
        }
        frag.appendChild(op);
    }
    sel.appendChild(frag);
    // Surface unknown row values so the user sees the bad data instead
    // of a misleadingly-blank select. Inserted after the placeholder.
    if (!matched && currentValStr.trim() !== '') {
        var unknown = document.createElement('option');
        unknown.value = currentValStr;
        unknown.textContent = 'Unknown: ' + currentValStr;
        unknown.selected = true;
        unknown.style.color = '#b91c1c';
        sel.insertBefore(unknown, sel.firstChild.nextSibling);
    }
}

function _initLazyVocabSelect(sel, opts, currentValStr) {
    // Pre-populate just the blank placeholder + current value (if any)
    // so the cell looks correct before the user interacts with it.
    var blank = document.createElement('option');
    blank.value = ''; blank.textContent = '(blank)';
    sel.appendChild(blank);
    if (currentValStr.trim() !== '') {
        // Check whether the current value matches the vocab so the
        // pre-populated option carries the right label (rather than
        // duplicating it as Unknown).
        var match = null;
        var s = currentValStr.toLowerCase();
        for (var i = 0; i < opts.length; i++) {
            if (String(opts[i].value).toLowerCase() === s ||
                String(opts[i].label).toLowerCase() === s) { match = opts[i]; break; }
        }
        var cur = document.createElement('option');
        if (match) {
            cur.value = match.value; cur.textContent = match.label;
        } else {
            cur.value = currentValStr;
            cur.textContent = 'Unknown: ' + currentValStr;
            cur.style.color = '#b91c1c';
        }
        cur.selected = true;
        sel.appendChild(cur);
    }
    // Defer the full build to first focus. One-shot listener (removes
    // itself after running) so we never repopulate.
    sel._fbOpts = opts;
    sel.addEventListener('focus', _lazyFocusOnce);
}

function _lazyFocusOnce(e) {
    var sel = e.currentTarget;
    sel.removeEventListener('focus', _lazyFocusOnce);
    var opts = sel._fbOpts;
    if (!opts) return;
    var currentVal = sel.value;
    // Clear all existing options (placeholder + maybe a current/unknown).
    while (sel.firstChild) sel.removeChild(sel.firstChild);
    // Rebuild from scratch including the full options.
    _populateVocabSelect(sel, opts, currentVal);
    sel._fbOpts = null;
}

function _buildBodyRow(row, idx, schema) {
    var tr = document.createElement('tr');
    tr.dataset.rowIdx = idx;
    if (state.selectedRows.has(row)) tr.classList.add('row-selected');

    // Select checkbox — leftmost (before the delete button). Toggling
    // adds/removes the row OBJECT from state.selectedRows; row index isn't
    // used as the selection key because sorting reorders the displayed
    // index without changing identity.
    var selTd = document.createElement('td');
    selTd.className = 'row-select-cell';
    var selCb = document.createElement('input');
    selCb.type = 'checkbox';
    selCb.checked = state.selectedRows.has(row);
    setRichTip(selCb, { title: 'Select row', desc: 'Mark this row for the bulk-delete toolbar action.', meta: 'Selection persists across filter / sort changes' });
    selCb.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
    selCb.addEventListener('change', function () {
        if (selCb.checked) state.selectedRows.add(row);
        else state.selectedRows.delete(row);
        tr.classList.toggle('row-selected', selCb.checked);
        _updateHeaderSelectCheckbox();
        _updateBulkDeleteButton();
    });
    selTd.appendChild(selCb);
    tr.appendChild(selTd);

    // Delete button — to the right of the select checkbox. Confirms via
    // the shared ConfirmModal (showing a short row-identification snippet
    // so the user knows which row is about to disappear).
    var delTd = document.createElement('td');
    delTd.className = 'row-delete-cell';
    var delBtn = document.createElement('button');
    delBtn.type = 'button';
    delBtn.className = 'row-delete-btn';
    setRichTip(delBtn, { title: 'Delete row', desc: 'Remove this single row from the import. The source CSV file is not changed.', meta: 'Will prompt for confirmation · undo with Ctrl+Z' });
    delBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Delete row');
    delBtn.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">' +
        '<polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"/>' +
        '<path d="M19 6l-1.5 14a2 2 0 0 1-2 1.8H8.5a2 2 0 0 1-2-1.8L5 6"/>' +
        '<path d="M10 11v6"/><path d="M14 11v6"/>' +
        '<path d="M9 6V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"/>' +
        '</svg>';
    delBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { promptDeleteRow(row); });
    delTd.appendChild(delBtn);
    tr.appendChild(delTd);

    // Status pill.
    var stTd = document.createElement('td');
    stTd.className = 'row-status-cell';
    var pill = document.createElement('span');
    pill.className = 'row-status ' + (row._status || 'ready');
    pill.textContent = (row._status === 'issues') ? 'Issues' : 'Ready';
    if (row._status === 'issues') {
        var n = Object.keys(row._cellIssues || {}).length;
        pill.textContent = 'Issues (' + n + ')';
        setRichTip(pill, {
            title: n + ' issue' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' on this row',
            desc: Object.keys(row._cellIssues || {}).map(function (k) {
                return '• ' + k + ': ' + row._cellIssues[k];
            }).join('\n'),
            meta: 'Source CSV row ' + row._sourceRowNum
        });
    }
    stTd.appendChild(pill);
    tr.appendChild(stTd);

    // Source row index.
    var srcTd = document.createElement('td');
    srcTd.className = 'source-row-cell';
    srcTd.textContent = row._sourceRowNum;
    tr.appendChild(srcTd);

    // Data cells. When the "show only errored columns" filter is on,
    // state._visibleColKeys carries the set of columns to render.
    var visibleColKeys = state._visibleColKeys;
    _visibleColumns(schema).forEach(function (col) {
        if (visibleColKeys && !visibleColKeys.has(col.key)) return;

        var td = document.createElement('td');
        // data-col-key kept for _refreshRowDisplay cell-wash refresh
        // (which queries by index) and any future per-cell tooling.
        // data-rowIdx kept symmetrically; both are cheap and harmless.
        td.dataset.rowIdx = idx;
        td.dataset.colKey = col.key;
        if (row._cellIssues && row._cellIssues[col.key]) {
            td.className = 'cell-issue';
            setRichTip(td, { title: col.key + ' — issue', desc: row._cellIssues[col.key], meta: 'Required cell · fix to clear the row’s status pill', required: true });
        } else if (row._cellWarnings && row._cellWarnings[col.key]) {
            td.className = 'cell-warning';
            setRichTip(td, { title: col.key + ' — warning', desc: row._cellWarnings[col.key], meta: 'Optional field · doesn’t block import but should be reviewed' });
        }

        var opts = col.vocab ? vocabOptions(col.vocab) : null;
        var el;
        if (opts && opts.length) {
            el = document.createElement('select');
            el.className = 'cell-select';
            var rowVal = row[col.key];
            var rowValStr = rowVal == null ? '' : String(rowVal);
            // ── LAZY POPULATION (perf) ─────────────────────────────────
            // For big vocab lists (existingVendors, existingCustomers,
            // currencies — anything with >50 options) we DON'T pre-build
            // every <option> element on every cell. With 200 rendered
            // rows × ~1000 vendors per Vendor cell, that's 200k option
            // nodes per render → multi-second freezes on every filter
            // change. Instead, we render only the currently-selected
            // value + a blank placeholder, then populate the full
            // option list on the FIRST `focus` event (when the user is
            // about to use the dropdown). The cost moves from "every
            // render of every cell" to "first click per cell" — barely
            // perceptible because by then it's a single user action.
            // ----
            // Small vocabs (≤50: UOMs, statuses, boolean, enums) still
            // build eagerly because the savings aren't worth the focus-
            // listener overhead, and the user expects the dropdown to
            // open instantly.
            if (opts.length > 50) {
                _initLazyVocabSelect(el, opts, rowValStr);
            } else {
                _populateVocabSelect(el, opts, rowValStr);
            }
        } else {
            el = document.createElement('input');
            el.className = 'cell-input';
            el.type = 'text';
            el.value = row[col.key] == null ? '' : String(row[col.key]);
        }
        el.addEventListener('change', function () {
            var oldValue = row[col.key];
            var v = el.value;
            // Decimal / Numeric columns: normalise on commit so what's stored
            // (and exported) is the clean number — Shopify exports often
            // include $ and commas in cost columns. If the value can't be
            // parsed at all, leave it untouched so validateRow flags it and
            // the user can see what they typed.
            if (col.type === 'Decimal' || col.type === 'Numeric') {
                var n = normalizeDecimal(v);
                if (n !== null) { v = n; el.value = n; }
            }
            if (v === oldValue) return;   // no-op (same as before) — don't pollute history
            row[col.key] = v;
            History.push({ type: 'set', rowIdx: idx, colKey: col.key, oldValue: oldValue, newValue: v });
            if (col.unique) {
                // Editing a unique column (PartNumber) can introduce or
                // resolve duplicates on ANY other row in the table — the
                // single-row fast path would leave their pill / cell wash
                // wrong. Recompute everything + redraw.
                validateAllRows();
                renderResultsTable();
            } else {
                validateRow(row, schema);
                updateSummaryStats();
                _refreshRowDisplay(tr, row, schema);
            }
        });
        td.appendChild(el);
        tr.appendChild(td);
    });

    return tr;
}

function _refreshRowDisplay(tr, row, schema) {
    // Status pill.
    var pill = tr.querySelector('.row-status');
    if (pill) {
        pill.className = 'row-status ' + (row._status || 'ready');
        if (row._status === 'issues') {
            var n = Object.keys(row._cellIssues || {}).length;
            pill.textContent = 'Issues (' + n + ')';
            setRichTip(pill, {
                title: n + ' issue' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' on this row',
                desc: Object.keys(row._cellIssues || {}).map(function (k) {
                    return '• ' + k + ': ' + row._cellIssues[k];
                }).join('\n'),
                meta: 'Source CSV row ' + row._sourceRowNum
            });
        } else {
            pill.textContent = 'Ready';
            setRichTip(pill, {});
        }
    }
    // Cell wash. When the "errored-columns" filter is on, only a subset of
    // schema columns are actually in the DOM — iterate the same filter so
    // td indices line up. tdIdx starts at 4 (select + delete + status + src#).
    var tds = tr.querySelectorAll('td');
    var visibleColKeys = state._visibleColKeys;
    var tdIdx = 4;
    _visibleColumns(schema).forEach(function (col) {
        if (visibleColKeys && !visibleColKeys.has(col.key)) return;
        var td = tds[tdIdx++];
        if (!td) return;
        // Preserve the data-row-idx / data-col-key attributes — only swap
        // the class and title so any future cell-level tooling that
        // queries by these can keep working.
        if (row._cellIssues && row._cellIssues[col.key]) {
            td.className = 'cell-issue';
            setRichTip(td, { title: col.key + ' — issue', desc: row._cellIssues[col.key], meta: 'Required cell · fix to clear the row’s status pill', required: true });
        } else if (row._cellWarnings && row._cellWarnings[col.key]) {
            td.className = 'cell-warning';
            setRichTip(td, { title: col.key + ' — warning', desc: row._cellWarnings[col.key], meta: 'Optional field · doesn’t block import but should be reviewed' });
        } else {
            td.className = '';
            setRichTip(td, {});   // strips data-tt-* so no tooltip
        }
    });
}

// Per-cell drag-drop removed (2026-06-27). It was slow on large imports
// and copy-paste in the cell editor + the bulk-overwrite "Copy from
// column" affordance cover the same use cases. Search-history note: the
// previous implementation lived here as `_wireCellDragDrop()` and used a
// custom `application/x-ib-cell` MIME type on the DataTransfer.

// ============================================================================
// EXPORT
// ============================================================================
function _buildExportCsv() {
    var schema = FB_SCHEMAS[state.targetKind];
    // Region-filter so hidden tax columns (PartTaxCode in US / ProductTaxable in
    // APAC / TaxRate in US-Customer / TaxExempt in APAC-Customer) never reach
    // the exported CSV. Fishbowl's import treats absent columns as "leave
    // Fishbowl default", which is what we want for the unused-in-region one.
    // Pass `true` to ignore the user's per-target column-visibility hides
    // — those are screen-only; the export must always include every
    // region-applicable column in the canonical Fishbowl order.
    var headers = _visibleColumns(schema, true).map(function (c) { return c.key; });
    var rows = state.targetRows.map(function (r) {
        var copy = {};
        headers.forEach(function (h) { copy[h] = r[h] == null ? '' : r[h]; });
        return copy;
    });
    return { headers: headers, rows: rows };
}
function exportTargetCsv() {
    if (!state.targetRows.length) { showMessage('No rows to export', 'warn'); return; }
    var d = _buildExportCsv();
    var csv = buildCsv(d.headers, d.rows);
    var fname = 'fishbowl_' + state.targetKind + '_' + new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] + '.csv';
    downloadFile(csv, fname, 'text/csv');
    showMessage('Exported ' + d.rows.length + ' rows → ' + fname, 'success');
}

// SETTINGS PANEL CONTROLLER  (mirrors Solidworks_BOM_Converter.htm's PageSettings)
// ============================================================================
function _val(id, dflt) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value : dflt; }
function _chk(id, dflt) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.checked : dflt; }
function _setVal(id, v) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el && v !== undefined && v !== null) el.value = v; }
function _setChk(id, v) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el && v !== undefined) el.checked = !!v; }

function _collectSettings() {
    return {
        defaultUOM:              _val('defaultUOM', 'ea'),
        defaultTaxCode:          _val('defaultTaxCode', 'NON'),
        defaultWeightUOM:        _val('defaultWeightUOM', 'kg'),
        defaultCustomerStatus:   _val('defaultCustomerStatus', 'Normal'),
        defaultCustomerPriority: _val('defaultCustomerPriority', '3-Normal'),
        defaultVendorStatus:     _val('defaultVendorStatus', 'Normal'),
        defaultAccountPrefix:    _val('defaultAccountPrefix', 'SHOP-'),
        region:                  _val('region', 'auto')
    };
}
function persistSettings() {
    var s = _collectSettings();
    try {
        if (_settingsReady()) {
            Object.keys(s).forEach(function (k) { FBLib.Settings.setUserKey(k, s[k]); });
            FBLib.Settings.saveUser();
            debugLog('Settings saved to user account', 'info');
        }
    } catch (e) { debugLog('Settings save failed: ' + e.message, 'warn'); }
}

// Region select onchange — persist, re-resolve the active region, refresh
// the "(resolved as: X)" hint, then re-seed mappings + re-validate + re-render
// so the hidden tax column disappears (or reappears) immediately. Without
// the re-seed the previous mapping for the now-hidden column would linger
// in state.fieldMappings; harmless but confusing if the user toggles back.
function onRegionChange() {
    persistSettings();
    var prev = state.activeRegion;
    state.activeRegion = detectRegion();
    _updateRegionResolvedNote();
    debugLog('Region changed: ' + prev + ' → ' + state.activeRegion, 'info');
    if (prev === state.activeRegion) return;
    if (state.sourceHeaders.length) seedFieldMappings();
    if (state.targetRows.length) {
        validateAllRows();
        renderResultsTable();
    }
}

// Display the resolved region next to the dropdown so the user can see what
// "Auto" picked (e.g. "Auto-detect from Fishbowl (resolved as: APAC)").
function _updateRegionResolvedNote() {
    var note = document.getElementById('regionResolvedNote');
    if (!note) return;
    var setting = _resolve('region', 'auto');
    if (setting === 'auto') {
        note.textContent = 'Auto resolved to: ' + state.activeRegion.toUpperCase();
    } else {
        note.textContent = '';
    }
}
function hydrateSettings() {
    _setVal('defaultUOM',              _resolve('defaultUOM', 'ea'));
    _setVal('defaultTaxCode',          _resolve('defaultTaxCode', 'NON'));
    _setVal('defaultWeightUOM',        _resolve('defaultWeightUOM', 'kg'));
    _setVal('defaultCustomerStatus',   _resolve('defaultCustomerStatus', 'Normal'));
    _setVal('defaultCustomerPriority', _resolve('defaultCustomerPriority', '3-Normal'));
    _setVal('defaultVendorStatus',     _resolve('defaultVendorStatus', 'Normal'));
    _setVal('defaultAccountPrefix',    _resolve('defaultAccountPrefix', 'SHOP-'));
    _setVal('region',                  _resolve('region', 'auto'));
    _setChk('showDebug',               DEBUG_MODE);
}

window.PageSettings = (function () {
    function _has() { return _settingsReady(); }
    function init() {
        try {
            var admin = document.getElementById('dsAdminSection');
            if (admin) admin.style.display = (_has() && FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) ? 'block' : 'none';
            refreshLockUI();
        } catch (e) {}
    }
    function refreshLockUI() {
        if (!_has()) return;
        try {
            var allowed = FBLib.Settings.userEditingAllowed();
            var badge = document.getElementById('dsLockBadge');
            if (badge) badge.style.display = (!allowed && !FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) ? 'block' : 'none';
            var btn = document.getElementById('dsLockBtn');
            if (btn) btn.textContent = allowed ? 'Lock user editing' : 'Unlock user editing';
        } catch (e) {}
    }
    function openPanel() {
        hydrateSettings();
        refreshLockUI();
        // Only one drop-down drawer open at a time — close any others first.
        try { window.HelpPanel   && window.HelpPanel.close();    } catch (e) {}
        try { window.SourcePanel && window.SourcePanel.close();  } catch (e) {}
        document.getElementById('setOverlay').classList.add('open');
        var btn = document.getElementById('setBtn');
        if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
    }
    function closePanel() {
        document.getElementById('setOverlay').classList.remove('open');
        var btn = document.getElementById('setBtn');
        if (btn) btn.classList.remove('active');
    }
    function togglePanel() {
        var open = document.getElementById('setOverlay').classList.contains('open');
        if (open) closePanel(); else openPanel();
    }
    function resetToDefaults() {
        if (!confirm('Reset your personal settings to defaults?')) return;
        try { if (_has()) FBLib.Settings.clearUser(); } catch (e) {}
        hydrateSettings();
        showMessage('Settings reset to defaults', 'info');
    }
    function publishMaster() {
        if (!_has() || !FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) return;
        if (!confirm('Publish current settings as the default for all users?')) return;
        try { FBLib.Settings.publishMaster(_collectSettings()); showMessage('Published as default for everyone', 'success'); } catch (e) {}
    }
    function toggleLock() {
        if (!_has() || !FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) return;
        try {
            var nowLocked = FBLib.Settings.userEditingAllowed();
            FBLib.Settings.setLock(nowLocked);
            refreshLockUI();
            showMessage('User editing: ' + (nowLocked ? 'LOCKED' : 'UNLOCKED'), 'info');
        } catch (e) {}
    }
    return { init: init, openPanel: openPanel, closePanel: closePanel, togglePanel: togglePanel,
        resetToDefaults: resetToDefaults, publishMaster: publishMaster, toggleLock: toggleLock };
})();

window.HelpPanel = {
    open: function () {
        try { window.PageSettings && window.PageSettings.closePanel(); } catch (e) {}
        try { window.SourcePanel  && window.SourcePanel.close();       } catch (e) {}
        document.getElementById('helpOverlay').classList.add('open');
        var btn = document.getElementById('helpBtn');
        if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
    },
    close: function () {
        document.getElementById('helpOverlay').classList.remove('open');
        var btn = document.getElementById('helpBtn');
        if (btn) btn.classList.remove('active');
    },
    toggle: function () {
        var open = document.getElementById('helpOverlay').classList.contains('open');
        if (open) this.close(); else this.open();
    }
};

// ESC key closes any open drop-down drawer.
document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
    try { window.PageSettings && window.PageSettings.closePanel(); } catch (_) {}
    try { window.HelpPanel    && window.HelpPanel.close();         } catch (_) {}
    try { window.SourcePanel  && window.SourcePanel.close();       } catch (_) {}
});

// ============================================================================
// INIT
// ============================================================================
(function init() {
    // Read the user's persisted setting. Default is false; we no longer
    // honour the BI_SHOW_DEBUG system property (see DEBUG_MODE comment).
    DEBUG_MODE = !!_resolve('showDebug', false);
    // Mount the shared debug drawer (fb-lib). Idempotent + lazy — the
    // helper handles the "fb-lib not yet hot" edge case by returning null,
    // and toggleDebugConsole() will retry the mount when the user ticks
    // the checkbox.
    var api = _ensureDrawer();
    if (api) {
        if (DEBUG_MODE) { api.show(); api.expand(); }
        else             api.hide();
        // Observe drawer dimensions so <body>'s padding-bottom CSS var
        // (--debug-drawer-h) keeps the always-fixed debug drawer from
        // overlapping the bottom rows of the results table. Listens to
        // both class changes (show/hide, expand/collapse) and content
        // resize (user drags the resize handle on the drawer's top
        // edge). Idempotent — observer-attached flag on the element.
        if (api.element) _observeDebugDrawer(api.element);
    }
    _setChk('showDebug', DEBUG_MODE);

    hydrateSettings();
    // Resolve tax region BEFORE the first schema iteration (mapping seed,
    // results render, export). currencyLocale() is a synchronous Fishbowl
    // built-in so this won't block. Outside Fishbowl (preview/standalone),
    // detectRegion() falls back to 'us'.
    state.activeRegion = detectRegion();
    _updateRegionResolvedNote();
    debugLog('Tax region resolved: ' + state.activeRegion + ' (setting=' + _resolve('region', 'auto') + ')', 'info');
    try { PageSettings.init(); } catch (e) {}

    // Register the two drop-down drawers with fb-lib so mutual-exclusion +
    // ESC-to-close + trigger-button .active toggling are handled centrally.
    // (PageSettings/HelpPanel still own their open/close internals; this
    // hooks them in for the cross-drawer plumbing only.)
    try {
        if (FBLib && FBLib.Common && FBLib.Common.registerDrawer) {
            FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'setOverlay',    triggerId: 'setBtn'    });
            FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'helpOverlay',   triggerId: 'helpBtn'   });
            FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'sourceOverlay', triggerId: 'sourceBtn' });
        }
    } catch (e) {}

    // Restore per-user table-display preferences: frozen-first-column state
    // and per-target hidden columns. Both are written by toggleFirstColLock
    // / the columns picker; reading them here means the user's last
    // preferences are honoured on first render.
    state.frozenFirstCol = !!_resolve('frozenFirstCol', false);
    _restoreHiddenCols();
    updateColumnsButtonLabel();

    debugLog('Import Builder initialized', 'info');
    if (typeof runQuery !== 'function') {
        debugLog('runQuery unavailable — running outside Fishbowl. CSV transform + export will still work; reference dropdowns will be empty.', 'warn');
    } else {
        loadFishbowlReference();
    }
})();
</script>
